quote: The muscle pH value increased initially and then decreased with the prolongation of transportation time (Figure 5).
statement: 随着运输时间的延长，肌肉pH值先升高后降低。
text_zh: 随着运输时间的延长，肌肉pH值先升高后降低。
text_en: As transport time increases, muscle pH first rises and then falls.

quote: As shown in Figure 5 , the ATP content in muscle shows a trend of first decreasing and then increasing with the prolongation of transport time.
statement: 如图5所示，随着运输时间的延长，肌肉中的ATP含量呈现先下降后上升的趋势。
text_zh: 如图5所示，随着运输时间的延长，肌肉中的ATP含量呈现先下降后上升的趋势。
text_en: As shown in Figure 5, with the extension of transport time, the ATP content in muscle showed a trend of first decreasing and then increasing.

quote: the transcription levels of caspase 3 , caspase 8 , caspase 9 , and bax all exhibited an upward trend with prolonged transport time. with transportation time, whereas bcl-2 decreased.
statement: 随着运输时间延长，caspase 3、caspase 8、caspase 9和bax的转录水平均呈上升趋势，而bcl-2下降。
text_zh: 随着运输时间延长，caspase 3、caspase 8、caspase 9和bax的转录水平均呈上升趋势，而bcl-2下降。
text_en: As transport time increased, the transcription levels of caspase 3, caspase 8, caspase 9 and bax showed an upward trend, while bcl-2 decreased.

quote: In the scallion white group, AST was higher than in the ginger group and control at 12–24 h, but fell below the control by 36–48 h
statement: 在葱白组中，12-24小时的AST高于姜组和对照组，但在36-48小时降至对照组以下。
text_zh: 在葱白组中，12-24小时的AST高于姜组和对照组，但在36-48小时降至对照组以下。
text_en: In the scallion white group, AST levels were higher than those in the ginger group and the control group at 12-24 hours, but dropped below the control group at 36-48 hours.

quote: the liver tissue in the control group exhibited marked damage, characterized by disorganized hepatocyte arrangement, indistinct cellular boundaries, and pronounced vacuolation of hepatocytes.
statement: 对照组的肝组织表现出明显损伤，特征为肝细胞排列紊乱、细胞边界不清以及肝细胞明显空泡化。
text_zh: 对照组的肝组织表现出明显损伤，特征为肝细胞排列紊乱、细胞边界不清以及肝细胞明显空泡化。
text_en: The liver tissue of the control group showed obvious damage, characterized by disordered arrangement of hepatocytes, unclear cell boundaries, and significant vacuolization of hepatocytes.

quote: Regarding gill structure, the control group exhibited severe damage, characterized by extensive dissociation, disorganization, and rupture, along with marked vacuolation of chloride cells.
statement: 关于鳃结构，对照组表现出严重损伤，特征为广泛解离、紊乱和破裂，以及氯细胞明显空泡化。
text_zh: 关于鳃结构，对照组表现出严重损伤，特征为广泛解离、紊乱和破裂，以及氯细胞明显空泡化。
text_en: Regarding gill structure, the control group showed severe damage, characterized by widespread dissociation, disorganization and rupture, as well as obvious vacuolization of chloride cells.

quote: In contrast, the scallion white extract group showed relatively orderly secondary lamellae and more intact epithelial cell structures, with alleviated damage.
statement: 相比之下，葱白提取物组显示出相对有序的次级鳃瓣和更完整的上皮细胞结构，损伤得到缓解。
text_zh: 相比之下，葱白提取物组显示出相对有序的次级鳃瓣和更完整的上皮细胞结构，损伤得到缓解。
text_en: In contrast, the Allium fistulosum extract group showed relatively orderly secondary gill lamellae and more complete epithelial cell structure, with alleviated damage.

quote: The ginger extract group demonstrated clearer gill architecture with well-arranged lamellae, showing more pronounced improvement in tissue integrity.
statement: 姜提取物组显示出更清晰的鳃结构和排列良好的鳃瓣，表明组织完整性的改善更为显著。
text_zh: 姜提取物组显示出更清晰的鳃结构和排列良好的鳃瓣，表明组织完整性的改善更为显著。
text_en: The ginger extract group showed clearer gill structures and well-arranged gill lamellae, indicating a more significant improvement in tissue integrity.

quote: at 48 h, it was significantly elevated in the scallion white and ginger extract groups relative to the control.
statement: 在48小时时，葱白组和姜提取物组的SOD活性相对于对照组显著升高。
text_zh: 在48小时时，葱白组和姜提取物组的SOD活性相对于对照组显著升高。
text_en: At 48 hours, SOD activity in the scallion white group and ginger extract group was significantly higher than that of the control group.

quote: Following this loss, the diseased carp were removed and the water pH was adjusted with CaO and MgSiO 4 to 6.5–8.5, the recommended water pH range for freshwater fish (Svobodová, Lloyd, Máchová, & Vykusová, 1993).
statement: 在疾病爆发后，移除了患病鲤鱼并使用CaO和MgSiO4将水的pH值调整至6.5-8.5。
text_zh: 在疾病爆发后，移除了患病鲤鱼并使用CaO和MgSiO4将水的pH值调整至6.5-8.5。
text_en: After the disease outbreak, diseased carp were removed and CaO and MgSiO4 were used to adjust the water pH to 6.5-8.5.
intervention: Remove diseased fish and adjust pH

quote: Pond water is changed annually between February and March before a new round of culture begins.
statement: 池塘水每年在二月和三月之间更换一次，然后开始新一轮养殖。
text_zh: 池塘水每年在二月和三月之间更换一次，然后开始新一轮养殖。
text_en: Pond water is changed once a year between February and March, after which a new farming cycle begins.

quote: Detection of aquatic pathogens
statement: 该部分描述了水生病原体的检测方法。
text_zh: 该部分描述了水生病原体的检测方法。
text_en: This section describes methods for detecting aquatic pathogens.

quote: Polymerase chain reaction primers and probes used for pathogen detection in water and sediment samples have been published previously (Table A1).
statement: 用于水和沉积物样本中病原体检测的聚合酶链反应引物和探针已在之前的文献中发表。
text_zh: 用于水和沉积物样本中病原体检测的聚合酶链反应引物和探针已在之前的文献中发表。
text_en: Primers and probes for the detection of pathogens in water and sediment samples have been published in previous literature.

quote: microorganisms are beneficial for fish propagation in ponds because microbes affect water quality, inhibit harmful pathogens, improve digestibility, and maintain the microecological balance.
statement: 微生物通过影响水质、抑制有害病原体、提高消化率和维持微生态平衡，对池塘鱼类养殖有益。
text_zh: 微生物通过影响水质、抑制有害病原体、提高消化率和维持微生态平衡，对池塘鱼类养殖有益。
text_en: Microorganisms benefit pond fish farming by affecting water quality, inhibiting harmful pathogens, improving digestibility, and maintaining microecological balance.

quote: Disruption of the microecological balance in an aquaculture environment is one of the key reasons for disease outbreaks, and fish diseases occur when pathogenic microorganisms propagate and prevail (Murray & Peeler, 2005).
statement: 养殖环境中微生态平衡的破坏是疾病爆发的关键原因之一，当致病微生物繁殖并占优势时就会发生鱼类疾病。
text_zh: 养殖环境中微生态平衡的破坏是疾病爆发的关键原因之一，当致病微生物繁殖并占优势时就会发生鱼类疾病。
text_en: The disruption of microecological balance in the farming environment is one of the key causes of disease outbreaks; fish diseases occur when pathogenic microorganisms multiply and become dominant.

quote: various reports have shown that microbial community structures are affected by aquaculture methods and are correlated with hardness, ammonia level, total nitrogen level, and other environmental parameters
statement: 各种报告表明，微生物群落结构受养殖方法的影响，并与硬度、氨氮水平、总氮水平和其他环境参数相关。
text_zh: 各种报告表明，微生物群落结构受养殖方法的影响，并与硬度、氨氮水平、总氮水平和其他环境参数相关。
text_en: Various reports indicate that microbial community structure is influenced by farming methods and is correlated with hardness, ammonia nitrogen levels, total nitrogen levels, and other environmental parameters.
outcome: 微生物群落与环境关联

quote: The concentrations of NH 4 + ‐N and NO 3 − ‐N in the SY pond exhibited a decreasing trend, whereas the NO 2 − ‐N concentration increased to a dangerously high level, as 0.1 mg/L is the upper limit for NO 2 − ‐N levels in breeding ponds (Svobodová et al., 1993).
statement: 射阳池塘中铵态氮和硝态氮浓度呈下降趋势，而亚硝态氮浓度升高至危险水平，因为养殖池中亚硝态氮的上限为0.1 mg/L。
text_zh: 射阳池塘中铵态氮和硝态氮浓度呈下降趋势，而亚硝态氮浓度升高至危险水平，因为养殖池中亚硝态氮的上限为0.1 mg/L。
text_en: In Sheyang ponds, ammonium nitrogen and nitrate nitrogen concentrations showed a downward trend, while nitrite nitrogen concentrations rose to dangerous levels, because the upper limit for nitrite nitrogen in aquaculture ponds is 0.1 mg/L.

quote: To quantify the selected pathogens in all samples, qPCR analysis using SYBR ® Premix Ex Taq™ (Tli RNaseH Plus; Takara Biotechnology) was performed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
statement: 使用SYBR Premix Ex Taq进行qPCR分析以量化所有样本中的选定病原体。
text_zh: 使用SYBR Premix Ex Taq进行qPCR分析以量化所有样本中的选定病原体。
text_en: qPCR analysis using SYBR Premix Ex Taq was performed to quantify selected pathogens in all samples.

quote: For CyHV‐2, qPCR amplification (probe qPCR) was performed in a 25 μl reaction volume containing 12.5 μl of 2 × Premix Ex Taq, 0.5 μl of each primer (0.2 μM final concentration), 1 μl of FAM‐labeled probe (0.2 μM final concentration), 2 μl of template DNA, and 8.5 μl DNase‐ and RNase‐free deionized water.
statement: 针对CyHV-2，在含有FAM标记探针的反应体系中进行探针法qPCR扩增。
text_zh: 针对CyHV-2，在含有FAM标记探针的反应体系中进行探针法qPCR扩增。
text_en: For CyHV-2, probe-based qPCR amplification was performed in a reaction system containing FAM-labeled probes.

quote: Identification and evaluation of aquaculture pathogens will facilitate the development of countermeasures to reduce pathogen contamination in ponds, and therefore, prevent subsequent outbreaks.
statement: 识别和评估水产养殖病原体有助于开发减少池塘病原体污染的对策，从而预防随后的疫情爆发。
text_zh: 识别和评估水产养殖病原体有助于开发减少池塘病原体污染的对策，从而预防随后的疫情爆发。
text_en: Identifying and assessing aquaculture pathogens helps develop countermeasures to reduce pathogen contamination in ponds, thereby preventing subsequent disease outbreaks.

quote: Our observations clearly indicate that a high concentration of CyHV‐2 was present in both the DF and SY ponds during the outbreak period in July.
statement: 观察表明，在七月份爆发期间，DF和SY池塘中均存在高浓度的CyHV-2。
text_zh: 观察表明，在七月份爆发期间，DF和SY池塘中均存在高浓度的CyHV-2。
text_en: Observations showed that high concentrations of CyHV-2 were present in both DF and SY ponds during the July outbreak.

quote: Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV‐2) infection is detrimental to gibel carp health and may result in severe economic loss in freshwater aquaculture.
statement: 鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）感染对异育银鲫的健康有害，并可能导致淡水养殖中的严重经济损失。
text_zh: 鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）感染对异育银鲫的健康有害，并可能导致淡水养殖中的严重经济损失。
text_en: Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2) infection is harmful to the health of allogynogenetic gibel carp and may cause severe economic losses in freshwater aquaculture.

quote: The results indicate that the concentrations of six selected pathogens were higher in the water than in the sediment and that these concentrations peaked during disease outbreak.
statement: 结果表明，六种选定病原体在水中的浓度高于沉积物中的浓度，且这些浓度在疾病爆发期间达到峰值。
text_zh: 结果表明，六种选定病原体在水中的浓度高于沉积物中的浓度，且这些浓度在疾病爆发期间达到峰值。
text_en: The results showed that the concentrations of six selected pathogens in water were higher than those in sediment, and these concentrations peaked during disease outbreaks.
outcome: 病原体丰度与环境分布

quote: In addition, bacterial diversity was associated with environmental factors (temperature, chemical oxygen demand, NO 2 − ‐N, NO 3 − ‐N, and NH 4 + ‐N) in the pond where the outbreak occurred.
statement: 此外，在发生疫情的池塘中，细菌多样性与环境因素（温度、化学需氧量、亚硝酸盐氮、硝酸盐氮和铵态氮）相关。
text_zh: 此外，在发生疫情的池塘中，细菌多样性与环境因素（温度、化学需氧量、亚硝酸盐氮、硝酸盐氮和铵态氮）相关。
text_en: In addition, in ponds with disease outbreaks, bacterial diversity was correlated with environmental factors (temperature, chemical oxygen demand, nitrite nitrogen, nitrate nitrogen, and ammonium nitrogen).
outcome: 水质参数与微生物多样性的关系

quote: We detected and quantified Aeromonas hydrophila , A. sobria , A. veronii , Plesiomonas shigelloides, CyHV‐2, and Saprolegnia spp., which are often detected in cultured gibel carp, from both pond water and sediment samples during and after an outbreak of infectious hematopoietic necrosis.
statement: 在传染性造血器官坏死病爆发期间及之后，从池塘水和沉积物样本中检测并定量了通常存在于养殖鲫鱼中的多种病原体。
text_zh: 在传染性造血器官坏死病爆发期间及之后，从池塘水和沉积物样本中检测并定量了通常存在于养殖鲫鱼中的多种病原体。
text_en: During and after an outbreak of infectious hematopoietic necrosis disease, multiple pathogens typically present in farmed crucian carp were detected and quantified from pond water and sediment samples.

quote: Concentrations of these selected pathogens in water and sediment samples were determined using qPCR‐based analysis from two freshwater aquaculture ponds (Figure 1).
statement: 使用基于qPCR的分析方法测定了两个淡水养殖池塘水和沉积物样本中选定病原体的浓度。
text_zh: 使用基于qPCR的分析方法测定了两个淡水养殖池塘水和沉积物样本中选定病原体的浓度。
text_en: The concentrations of selected pathogens in water and sediment samples from two freshwater aquaculture ponds were determined using a qPCR-based analytical method.
outcome: 水质与病原体负荷评估

quote: However, the NO 2 − ‐N, NH 4 + ‐N, and NO 3 − ‐N levels remained stable in the DF pond during the sampling period.
statement: 然而，在大丰池塘采样期间，亚硝态氮、铵态氮和硝态氮水平保持稳定。
text_zh: 然而，在大丰池塘采样期间，亚硝态氮、铵态氮和硝态氮水平保持稳定。
text_en: However, during sampling in Dafeng ponds, nitrite nitrogen, ammonium nitrogen, and nitrate nitrogen levels remained stable.

quote: The results suggest that the excessively low level of DO (4.41 ± 0.32 mg/L) and the dangerously high level of NO 2 − ‐ N (0.436 ± 0.02 mg/L) in the SY pond in July favored the disease outbreak.
statement: 结果表明，7月份射阳池塘中溶解氧过低（4.41 ± 0.32 mg/L）和亚硝态氮过高（0.436 ± 0.02 mg/L）有利于疾病爆发。
text_zh: 结果表明，7月份射阳池塘中溶解氧过低（4.41 ± 0.32 mg/L）和亚硝态氮过高（0.436 ± 0.02 mg/L）有利于疾病爆发。

quote: Among these genera, the relative abundance of both Mycobacterium and Ilumatobacter increased significantly during the disease period in the SY pond where the opposite trend was observed in the same month in the DF pond.
statement: 在SY池塘的疾病期间，分枝杆菌属和Ilumatobacter属的相对丰度显著增加，而在同月的DF池塘中观察到相反的趋势。
text_zh: 在SY池塘的疾病期间，分枝杆菌属和Ilumatobacter属的相对丰度显著增加，而在同月的DF池塘中观察到相反的趋势。
text_en: During the disease period in SY ponds, the relative abundance of Mycobacterium and Ilumatobacter significantly increased, while the opposite trend was observed in DF ponds in the same month.
outcome: 疾病与微生物群落关系
counterevidence: DF池塘在同月表现出相反趋势

quote: Proteobacteria, Actinobacteria, and Cyanobacteria were more abundant during the disease outbreak period than during the healthy period in the aquaculture ponds.
statement: 在养殖池塘中，变形菌门、放线菌门和蓝藻门在疾病爆发期间的丰度高于健康期间。
text_zh: 在养殖池塘中，变形菌门、放线菌门和蓝藻门在疾病爆发期间的丰度高于健康期间。
text_en: In aquaculture ponds, the abundance of Proteobacteria, Actinobacteria, and Cyanobacteria was higher during disease outbreaks than during healthy periods.
outcome: 特定细菌门类与疾病状态的关联

quote: Several cases of cultured gibel carp with body hyperemia, swollen bellies, and red gills have been reported in Jiangsu Province since 2009, resulting in considerable economic loss (Xu et al., 2013).
statement: 自2009年以来，江苏省报道了多例养殖鲫鱼出现体表充血、腹部肿胀和红鳃的症状，造成了巨大的经济损失。
text_zh: 自2009年以来，江苏省报道了多例养殖鲫鱼出现体表充血、腹部肿胀和红鳃的症状，造成了巨大的经济损失。
text_en: Since 2009, Jiangsu Province has reported multiple cases of farmed crucian carp exhibiting symptoms such as body surface congestion, abdominal swelling, and red gills, causing huge economic losses.

quote: Along with the motile Aeromonas species, CyHV‐2 is now considered one of the main causative agents of fish diseases, which has been confirmed by detailed bacteriological, histopathological, and virological studies on the gill, liver, brain, kidney, and spleen of affected fish (Fichi et al
statement: 与运动性气单胞菌一起，CyHV-2现在被认为是鱼类疾病的主要致病因子之一，这已通过受影响鱼的鳃、肝、脑、肾和脾的详细细菌学、组织病理学和病毒学研究得到证实。
text_zh: 与运动性气单胞菌一起，CyHV-2现在被认为是鱼类疾病的主要致病因子之一，这已通过受影响鱼的鳃、肝、脑、肾和脾的详细细菌学、组织病理学和病毒学研究得到证实。
text_en: Together with motile Aeromonas, CyHV-2 is now considered one of the major pathogenic factors in fish diseases, as confirmed by detailed bacteriological, histopathological and virological studies on the gills, liver, brain, kidney and spleen of affected fish.

quote: Comparative studies have been conducted based on the morphological, physiological, and molecular characteristics of Saprolegnia spp., identifying two pathogenic species in silver crucian carp and zebrafish and providing insights into the control of saprolegniasis (Ke, Wang, Gu, Li, & Gong, 2009).
statement: 基于形态、生理和分子特征的比较研究在银鲫和斑马鱼中鉴定出两种致病物种，并为水霉病的控制提供了见解。
text_zh: 基于形态、生理和分子特征的比较研究在银鲫和斑马鱼中鉴定出两种致病物种，并为水霉病的控制提供了见解。
text_en: A comparative study based on morphological, physiological, and molecular characteristics identified two pathogenic species in silver crucian carp and zebrafish, providing insights for the control of saprolegniasis.
intervention: Comparative morphological, physiological and molecular study
intervention_record: 形态生理分子比较研究

quote: Although aquaculture is becoming the fastest growing food‐producing industry, this sector currently faces substantial challenges with respect to the control of infectious diseases (Defoirdt, 2014).
statement: 尽管水产养殖正成为增长最快的食品生产行业，但该部门目前在传染病控制方面面临重大挑战。
text_zh: 尽管水产养殖正成为增长最快的食品生产行业，但该部门目前在传染病控制方面面临重大挑战。
text_en: Although aquaculture is becoming the fastest-growing food production industry, the sector currently faces significant challenges in infectious disease control.

quote: The above observations and evaluation of aquaculture pathogens will facilitate the development of countermeasures to reduce pathogen contamination in ponds and potentially prevent outbreaks of infectious diseases.
statement: 上述观察和对水产养殖病原体的评估将有助于制定减少池塘病原体污染的措施，并可能预防传染病爆发。
text_zh: 上述观察和对水产养殖病原体的评估将有助于制定减少池塘病原体污染的措施，并可能预防传染病爆发。
text_en: The above observations and the assessment of aquaculture pathogens will help develop measures to reduce pathogen contamination in ponds, and may prevent outbreaks of infectious diseases.

quote: High levels of pathogens, including CyHV‐2, were detected in the DF pond, which was free from disease.
statement: 在无病的DF池塘中检测到了高水平的病原体，包括CyHV-2。
text_zh: 在无病的DF池塘中检测到了高水平的病原体，包括CyHV-2。
text_en: High levels of pathogens, including CyHV-2, were detected in disease-free DF ponds.
outcome: 疾病爆发风险与病原体载量关系
counterevidence: 高病原体水平未导致疾病

quote: A significant correlation was observed between CyHV‐2 and Aeromonas spp. (p A3).
statement: CyHV-2与气单胞菌属之间存在显著相关性。
text_zh: CyHV-2与气单胞菌属之间存在显著相关性。
text_en: There is a significant correlation between CyHV-2 and Aeromonas.

quote: A positive correlation between DO level and CyHV‐2 concentration was observed in both DF and SY water samples.
statement: 在DF和SY的水样中，溶解氧水平与CyHV-2浓度呈正相关。
text_zh: 在DF和SY的水样中，溶解氧水平与CyHV-2浓度呈正相关。
text_en: In water samples from DF and SY, dissolved oxygen levels were positively correlated with CyHV-2 concentration.
outcome: 水质因子与病原体关系

quote: Furthermore, CyHV‐2 concentration was also correlated with pH in the SY pond and with the levels of NO 2 − ‐N and NO 3 − ‐N in the DF pond.
statement: 此外，SY池塘中CyHV-2浓度与pH值相关，DF池塘中与亚硝酸盐氮和硝酸盐氮水平相关。
text_zh: 此外，SY池塘中CyHV-2浓度与pH值相关，DF池塘中与亚硝酸盐氮和硝酸盐氮水平相关。
text_en: In addition, CyHV-2 concentration in SY ponds was correlated with pH, and in DF ponds it was correlated with nitrite nitrogen and nitrate nitrogen levels.
outcome: 水质因子与病原体关系

quote: Thus, appropriate measures must be adopted to not only improve the aquatic environment and maintain microecological balance, but also regularly monitor the dynamics of major pathogens for prevention of disease outbreaks in the future.
statement: 必须采取适当措施改善水环境、维持微生态平衡并定期监测主要病原体动态，以预防未来的疾病爆发。
text_zh: 必须采取适当措施改善水环境、维持微生态平衡并定期监测主要病原体动态，以预防未来的疾病爆发。
text_en: Appropriate measures must be taken to improve the water environment, maintain microecological balance, and regularly monitor the dynamics of major pathogens to prevent future disease outbreaks.

quote: CyHV‐2 is now considered one of the main causative agents of fish diseases, which has been confirmed by detailed bacteriological, histopathological, and virological studies on the gill, liver, brain, kidney, and spleen of affected fish (Fichi et al., 2013 ; Zhang, Yan, Bing, Qin, & Qin, 2010).
statement: CyHV-2被认为是鱼类疾病的主要致病因子之一，这一结论已通过受感染鱼类的鳃、肝、脑、肾和脾的详细细菌学、组织病理学和病毒学研究得到证实。
text_zh: CyHV-2被认为是鱼类疾病的主要致病因子之一，这一结论已通过受感染鱼类的鳃、肝、脑、肾和脾的详细细菌学、组织病理学和病毒学研究得到证实。
text_en: CyHV-2 is considered one of the major pathogenic factors for fish diseases, a conclusion that has been confirmed by detailed bacteriological, histopathological, and virological studies on the gills, liver, brain, kidney, and spleen of infected fish.

quote: The virus likely remains latent, considering the extended period before the outbreak of the disease, which is often triggered by environmental variations, such as water temperature and pH (Boitard et al., 2016 ; Goodwin, Sadler, Merry, & Marecaux, 2009).
statement: 考虑到疾病爆发前的潜伏期较长，该病毒可能处于潜伏状态，且疾病爆发通常由水温或pH值等环境变化触发。
text_zh: 考虑到疾病爆发前的潜伏期较长，该病毒可能处于潜伏状态，且疾病爆发通常由水温或pH值等环境变化触发。
text_en: Considering the long incubation period before disease outbreaks, the virus may be in a latent state, and disease outbreaks are usually triggered by environmental changes such as water temperature or pH.

quote: Molecular biological techniques, including real‐time Polymerase chain reaction and loop‐mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP), have been effectively developed and established for the detection and quantification of CyHV‐2 (He et al., 2013 ; Xu, Podok, Xie, & Lu, 2014).
statement: 包括实时聚合酶链反应和环介导等温扩增在内的分子生物学技术已被有效开发并建立，用于检测CyHV-2并进行定量分析。
text_zh: 包括实时聚合酶链反应和环介导等温扩增在内的分子生物学技术已被有效开发并建立，用于检测CyHV-2并进行定量分析。
text_en: Molecular biology techniques, including real-time polymerase chain reaction and loop-mediated isothermal amplification, have been effectively developed and established for the detection and quantitative analysis of CyHV-2.

statement: 然而，关于水生栖息地中CyHV-2和细菌病原体的研究有限，尽管这些病原体的控制相对容易。
text_zh: 然而，关于水生栖息地中CyHV-2和细菌病原体的研究有限，尽管这些病原体的控制相对容易。

quote: In aquatic systems, microorganisms are the principal participants in primary production, nutrient cycling, and decomposition, and are known to be closely associated with the physiological status, disease, and postharvest quality of cultured fish (Al‐Harbi & Uddin, 2005 ; DeLorenzo, Scott, & Ross, 2001).
statement: 在水生系统中，微生物是初级生产、营养循环和分解的主要参与者，并且已知与养殖鱼类的生理状态、疾病及采后质量密切相关。
text_zh: 在水生系统中，微生物是初级生产、营养循环和分解的主要参与者，并且已知与养殖鱼类的生理状态、疾病及采后质量密切相关。
text_en: In aquatic systems, microorganisms are the main participants in primary production, nutrient cycling and decomposition, and are known to be closely related to the physiological state, disease and post-harvest quality of farmed fish.

quote: Therefore, microorganisms are beneficial for fish propagation in ponds because microbes affect water quality, inhibit harmful pathogens,
statement: 因此，微生物对池塘中的鱼类繁殖有益，因为微生物影响水质并抑制有害病原体。

text_en: Therefore, microorganisms are beneficial for fish reproduction in ponds because they affect water quality and inhibit harmful pathogens.

quote: These results are consistent with those of a previous study that reported that NH 4 + ‐N, NO 2 − ‐N, and PO 4 3‐ in aquaculture water were positively correlated with the bacterial communities of sick fish (She et al., 2017).

text_zh: 先前的研究报道，养殖水中的铵态氮、亚硝态氮和磷酸盐与病鱼的细菌群落呈正相关。
text_en: Previous studies reported that ammoniacal nitrogen, nitrite nitrogen, and phosphate in aquaculture water were positively correlated with the bacterial communities of diseased fish.
outcome: 鱼类健康状态与水质指标关联

quote: These results suggest that, during a CyHV‐2 outbreak, environmental factors have greater influence over the structures of bacterial communities in ponds, and can be used as control measures for effectively regulating the microbial ecosystem.
statement: 结果表明，在CyHV-2爆发期间，环境因素对池塘细菌群落结构的影响更大，并可作为有效调节微生物生态系统的控制措施。
text_zh: 结果表明，在CyHV-2爆发期间，环境因素对池塘细菌群落结构的影响更大，并可作为有效调节微生物生态系统的控制措施。
text_en: The results showed that during the CyHV-2 outbreak, environmental factors had a greater impact on the structure of pond bacterial communities and could serve as control measures to effectively regulate the microbial ecosystem.

quote: 3.5. Variation of the bacterial community structure before and during the disease outbreak

text_en: Therefore, this disturbance of the balance can alter the microbial diversity and abundance of certain bacteria, and have beneficial or harmful effects on fish.
outcome: 微生物多样性与鱼类影响

text_en: This strain (Streptomyces enissocaesilis L-82) can improve the growth and immune performance of crucian carp, and enhance the resistance of crucian carp to Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: This study laid a theoretical foundation for the development of the strain into a microbial feed additive and its application in fish farming to enhance the disease resistance of fish.
statement: 本研究为将该菌株开发为微生物饲料添加剂并在鱼类养殖中应用以增强鱼类抗病力奠定了理论基础。

text_en: This study lays a theoretical foundation for developing this strain as a microbial feed additive and applying it in fish farming to enhance fish disease resistance.

quote: Our results demonstrated that during the disease period, both the concentrations of selected pathogens and bacterial diversity in the water of the SY pond significantly increased and were positively associated with DO, pH, and other water parameters.
statement: 结果显示，在疾病期间，SY池塘水中选定病原体的浓度和细菌多样性均显著增加，并与溶解氧、pH值及其他水质参数呈正相关。

text_en: The results showed that during the disease period, the concentrations of selected pathogens and bacterial diversity in SY pond water both increased significantly, and were positively correlated with dissolved oxygen, pH, and other water quality parameters.

text_en: Genome-wide analysis indicates that this strain has great disease resistance potential and is expected to be developed as a feed additive for aquaculture.

quote: With the continuous expansion of the scale of fish farming and the promotion of intensive farming models, the gradual increase in population density has also led to the deterioration of the breeding environment, providing a favorable environment for the survival and proliferation of conditional pathogenic bacteria in fish, which led to the outbreak of bacterial diseases in fish.

text_en: With the expansion of aquaculture scale and the promotion of intensive farming models, the gradual increase in population density leads to deterioration of the rearing environment, providing a favorable environment for the survival and reproduction of fish opportunistic pathogens, thereby triggering outbreaks of bacterial diseases in fish.

text_en: The occurrence of mycobacteria in natural water, reservoirs, and ponds has been investigated, particularly in freshwater fish farming, where these bacteria cause chronic diseases.

text_en: Previous studies have shown that the bacterial community composition in the farming environment or fish gut is affected by farming methods, stocking density, nutrient input, host development and seasonal changes.

quote: An additional important factor that affects the changes in microbial communities is disease outbreaks.

text_en: Another important factor affecting changes in microbial communities is disease outbreaks.

quote: The main members of this class, Aeromonas , Shewanella , Vibrio , Legionella , and Plesiomonas spp. are opportunistic pathogens, that can induce fish epizootic disease under stress.
statement: γ-变形菌纲的主要成员（如气单胞菌属、希瓦氏菌属、弧菌属等）是条件致病菌，在应激条件下可诱发鱼类流行病。
text_zh: γ-变形菌纲的主要成员（如气单胞菌属、希瓦氏菌属、弧菌属等）是条件致病菌，在应激条件下可诱发鱼类流行病。
text_en: The main members of Gammaproteobacteria (such as Aeromonas, Shewanella, Vibrio, etc.) are opportunistic pathogens that can induce fish epidemics under stress conditions.

quote: It can also regulate the host’s immune response and improve the host’s disease resistance and survival rate after infection with bacteria (Chen et al. 2023).
statement: Probiotics can regulate the host's immune response and improve disease resistance and survival rate after bacterial infection.
text_en: Probiotics can regulate the host's immune response and improve disease resistance and survival rate after bacterial infection.

quote: Streptomyces can secrete extra-hydrolytic enzymes to improve the activity of starch hydrolysis and protein hydrolysis in the digestive tract of the host, so as to make more effective use of feed (Cuozzo et al. 2023).
statement: Streptomyces secretes hydrolytic enzymes that improve starch and protein hydrolysis in the host's digestive tract, leading to more effective feed use.
text_en: Streptomyces secretes hydrolytic enzymes that improve starch and protein hydrolysis in the host's digestive tract, leading to more effective feed use.

quote: In order to use strains for disease prevention and control in fish farming, its biosafety must be evaluated first.
statement: 为了在水产养殖中使用菌株进行疾病防控，必须首先评估其生物安全性。

text_en: To use strains for disease prevention and control in aquaculture, their biosafety must first be assessed.

quote: Das et al. (2010) added Streptomyces to the feed, which increased the hydrolase activity in the digestive tract of Penaeus orientalis , helping it to use the feed more effectively and increase the weight of the shrimp.
statement: 在饲料中添加链霉菌增加了中国对虾消化道中的水解酶活性，帮助其更有效地利用饲料并增加体重。
text_zh: 在饲料中添加链霉菌增加了中国对虾消化道中的水解酶活性，帮助其更有效地利用饲料并增加体重。
text_en: Adding Streptomyces to feed increased the activity of hydrolytic enzymes in the digestive tract of Chinese shrimp, helping them utilize feed more effectively and increase body weight.

quote: You et al. (2005) reported a Streptomyces strain that can produce active substance siderophores and found that the Streptomyces can affect the growth of pathogenic Vibrio by competing for iron in the aquatic environment.
statement: 一种能产生铁载体活性物质的链霉菌菌株被发现可以通过在水生环境中竞争铁来影响致病性弧菌的生长。
text_zh: 一种能产生铁载体活性物质的链霉菌菌株被发现可以通过在水生环境中竞争铁来影响致病性弧菌的生长。
text_en: A Streptomyces strain capable of producing siderophore-active substances was found to affect the growth of pathogenic Vibrio by competing for iron in aquatic environments.

quote: Therefore, Streptomyces can be used as a microbial feed additive to help fish resist bacterial diseases and has great development potential in fish culture.
statement: 因此，链霉菌可用作微生物饲料添加剂，帮助鱼类抵抗细菌性疾病，在水产养殖中具有巨大的发展潜力。
text_zh: 因此，链霉菌可用作微生物饲料添加剂，帮助鱼类抵抗细菌性疾病，在水产养殖中具有巨大的发展潜力。
text_en: Therefore, Streptomyces can be used as a microbial feed additive to help fish resist bacterial diseases and has great development potential in aquaculture.

quote: Crucian carps were starved and domesticated without feed 48 h before the experiment.

text_en: Before the experiment, crucian carp were fasted and acclimated for 48 hours, during which no feed was provided.

quote: The results showed that the survival rate of the strain-feeding group was 26.67% higher than that of the control group.
statement: 饲喂L-82菌株组的鲫鱼存活率比对照组高26.67%。
text_zh: 饲喂L-82菌株组的鲫鱼存活率比对照组高26.67%。
text_en: The survival rate of crucian carp in the group fed with L-82 strain was 26.67% higher than that of the control group.

quote: It can be seen that the strain L-82 can enhance the resistance of crucian carp to A. hydrophila and protect the survival of crucian carp (Fig. 5 c).
statement: L-82菌株可以增强鲫鱼对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力并保护鲫鱼的存活。
text_zh: L-82菌株可以增强鲫鱼对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力并保护鲫鱼的存活。
text_en: The L-82 strain can enhance the resistance of crucian carp to Aeromonas hydrophila and protect the survival of crucian carp.

quote: In order to detect the antibacterial ability of strain L-82 in crucian carp, the strain AHXO40 mCherry was injected intraperitoneally into crucian carp, and the strain L-82 was fed after 7 days. Compared with the control group, the red fluorescence signal in the treatment group was weakened, indicating that the strain could inhibit the proliferation of pathogenic bacteria in crucian carp and resist the infection of pathogenic bacteria in crucian carp (Fig. 4 c).
statement: 在腹腔注射嗜水气单胞菌（AHXO40）后饲喂L-82菌株，治疗组红色荧光信号减弱，表明L-82能抑制病原菌增殖并抵抗感染。
text_zh: 在腹腔注射嗜水气单胞菌（AHXO40）后饲喂L-82菌株，治疗组红色荧光信号减弱，表明L-82能抑制病原菌增殖并抵抗感染。
text_en: After intraperitoneal injection with Aeromonas hydrophila (AHXO40), feeding the L-82 strain resulted in reduced red fluorescent signals in the treatment group, indicating that L-82 can inhibit pathogen proliferation and resist infection.

quote: The disadvantages of chemical drug methods for controlling fish diseases have been highlighted, and the development of eco-friendly methods is crucial.

text_zh: 化学药物治疗鱼类疾病的缺点已被强调，开发环保方法至关重要。
text_en: The disadvantages of chemical drug treatment for fish diseases have been emphasized, and developing environmentally friendly methods is crucial.
outcome: 疾病控制方法的环境影响

text_en: Antagonistic bacteria with probiotic functions can combat diseases, promote growth, and stimulate the host's immune response to infections.
outcome: 疾病抵抗、生长性能及免疫反应

quote: The antibacterial effect of strain L-82 fermentation broth with different fermentation times on A. hydrophila was detected.
statement: 检测了菌株L-82发酵液在不同发酵时间对嗜水气单胞菌的抗菌效果。

text_en: The antibacterial effect of strain L-82 fermentation broth against Aeromonas hydrophila was tested at different fermentation times.

quote: The results showed that the antibacterial active substances produced by the strain had a certain tolerance to high temperature, protease, pH, and UV, and showed high stability against A. hydrophila (Fig. 2).
statement: 结果表明，该菌株产生的抗菌活性物质对高温、蛋白酶、pH和紫外线具有一定的耐受性，并对嗜水气单胞菌表现出高稳定性。

text_en: The results showed that the antimicrobial active substances produced by this strain have a certain tolerance to high temperature, protease, pH, and ultraviolet light, and exhibit high stability against Aeromonas hydrophila.

text_en: After feeding with feed containing the strain at a concentration of 1×10^8 CFU/mL, the weight gain rate and specific growth rate of crucian carp increased, serum ACP and SOD activities increased, and survival rate after challenge improved.
outcome: 生长性能、抗氧化酶活性及抗病力

quote: Some strains can inhibit the colonization of pathogens through competitive exclusion, which may be due to competition of binding sites, synthesis of antibacterial compounds, immune stimulation, or competition of nutrients (Wuertz et al. 2021).

quote: In this study, it was proved that strain L-82 could stably colonize crucian carp and inhibit the growth of A. hydrophila by fluorescent protein labeling technology, which had a protective effect on crucian carp.
statement: 本研究证明，通过荧光蛋白标记技术，菌株L-82能够稳定定植于鲫鱼体内并抑制嗜水气单胞菌的生长，对鲫鱼具有保护作用。
text_zh: 本研究证明，通过荧光蛋白标记技术，菌株L-82能够稳定定植于鲫鱼体内并抑制嗜水气单胞菌的生长，对鲫鱼具有保护作用。
text_en: This study demonstrated that, through fluorescent protein labeling technology, strain L-82 can stably colonize within crucian carp and inhibit the growth of Aeromonas hydrophila, providing protective effects to crucian carp.

quote: However, the study of Streptomyce s enissocaesilis as a probiotic antagonistic bacteria and as a feed additive for fish disease control has not been reported.

text_en: There are currently no research reports on the use of Streptomyces enissocaesilis as a probiotic antagonist bacterium and feed additive for fish disease control.

quote: The minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) and minimum bactericidal concentration (MBC) of the fermentation broth of Streptomyce s enissocaesilis L-82 against A. hydrophila were 64 times and 16 times diluted, respectively.
statement: Streptomyces enissocaesilis L-82发酵液对嗜水气单胞菌的最小抑菌浓度（MIC）和最小杀菌浓度（MBC）分别为稀释64倍和16倍。

text_en: The minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) and minimum bactericidal concentration (MBC) of Streptomyces enissocaesilis L-82 fermentation broth against Aeromonas hydrophila were a dilution of 64-fold and 16-fold, respectively.

quote: This indicated that strain L-82 had a strong antibacterial ability against A. hydrophila and had the potential to be developed into an antibacterial agent for fish disease control.
statement: 这表明菌株L-82对嗜水气单胞菌具有很强的抗菌能力，并具有开发为鱼类疾病控制抗菌剂的潜力。

text_en: This indicates that strain L-82 has strong antibacterial activity against Aeromonas hydrophila and has the potential to be developed as an antibacterial agent for fish disease control.

text_en: After injection of silicon-based quantum dots, the concentration of advanced oxidation protein products (AOPP) in goldfish kidneys increased significantly on day 3 compared to the control group, while a non-significant difference of about 10% was observed on days 1 and 7.

quote: These oxidative markers correlate with the levels of dityrosine [ 37 ] and could reflect the QD’s exposed macrophage involvement in the oxidative stress in fish kidney.
