statement: 在注射硅基量子点的鱼肾脏中观察到改变，包括上皮细胞从基底膜脱落、肾小管扩张以及管腔内有碎片。
text_zh: 在注射硅基量子点的鱼肾脏中观察到改变，包括上皮细胞从基底膜脱落、肾小管扩张以及管腔内有碎片。
text_en: Changes were observed in the fish kidneys injected with silicon-based quantum dots, including detachment of epithelial cells from the basement membrane, dilation of renal tubules, and debris within the lumen.

quote: Feeding of pellet food at a rate of 1% of the body weight per day was stopped two days before initiation of the experiment, and no food was supplied to the fish during the experimental period.
statement: 实验前停止喂食，并在实验期间不供给食物。
text_zh: 实验前停止喂食，并在实验期间不供给食物。
text_en: Feeding was stopped before the experiment, and no food was provided during the experiment.

quote: Animal maintenance and experimental procedures were in accordance with the Guide for The Use and Care of Laboratory Animals (European Communities Council Directive 1986), and efforts were made to minimize animal suffering and reduce the number of specimens used.
statement: 动物饲养和实验程序遵循相关指南，并努力减少动物痛苦和样本数量。
text_zh: 动物饲养和实验程序遵循相关指南，并努力减少动物痛苦和样本数量。
text_en: Animal rearing and experimental procedures followed relevant guidelines, with efforts to reduce animal suffering and sample numbers.

quote: No mortality was noticed during the experiment.
statement: 实验期间未观察到死亡。
text_zh: 实验期间未观察到死亡。
text_en: No deaths were observed during the experimental period.

quote: six fish from each group were cervical dislocated under light ether anesthesia and dissected to draw the renal tissue.
statement: 在轻度乙醚麻醉下对鱼进行颈椎脱臼以获取肾组织。
text_zh: 在轻度乙醚麻醉下对鱼进行颈椎脱臼以获取肾组织。
text_en: Fish were euthanized by cervical dislocation under light ether anesthesia to obtain kidney tissue.

quote: Our results have shown that Hsp 70 protein expression in the kidney of IP injected fish with Si/SiO 2 QDs increased in a time-dependent manner: 1.33-, 1.65- and 1.88-fold, after 1, 3 and 7 days, respectively, compared to controls (Figure 5).
statement: 腹腔注射硅基量子点（Si/SiO2 QDs）导致鱼肾脏中Hsp 70蛋白表达呈时间依赖性增加，在1、3和7天后分别比对照组高1.33倍、1.65倍和1.88倍。
text_zh: 腹腔注射硅基量子点（Si/SiO2 QDs）导致鱼肾脏中Hsp 70蛋白表达呈时间依赖性增加，在1、3和7天后分别比对照组高1.33倍、1.65倍和1.88倍。
text_en: Intraperitoneal injection of silicon-based quantum dots (Si/SiO2 QDs) caused a time-dependent increase in Hsp 70 protein expression in fish kidneys, which was 1.33 times, 1.65 times, and 1.88 times higher than the control group after 1, 3, and 7 days, respectively.
outcome: 热休克蛋白表达/应激反应

quote: The Hsp 70 family is highly conserved and generally acts under stress conditions [ 48 ].
statement: Hsp 70家族高度保守，通常在应激条件下发挥作用。
text_zh: Hsp 70家族高度保守，通常在应激条件下发挥作用。
text_en: The Hsp70 family is highly conserved and typically functions under stress conditions.
outcome: 热休克蛋白的功能背景

quote: The total protein extract, deproteinated with 5% sulfosalicylic acid, was analyzed for total glutathione and oxidized glutathione (GSSG) using the Detect X ® Glutathione colorimetric detection kit and following manufacturer’s instructions.
statement: 使用Detect X®谷胱甘肽比色检测试剂盒分析总蛋白提取物中的总谷胱甘肽和氧化型谷胱甘肽（GSSG）。
text_zh: 使用Detect X®谷胱甘肽比色检测试剂盒分析总蛋白提取物中的总谷胱甘肽和氧化型谷胱甘肽（GSSG）。
text_en: Total glutathione and oxidized glutathione (GSSG) in total protein extracts were analyzed using the Detect X® Glutathione Colorimetric Assay Kit.

quote: The fish were acclimatized to laboratory conditions for three weeks prior to the experiment.
statement: 鱼类在实验前被驯化以适应实验室条件三周。
text_zh: 鱼类在实验前被驯化以适应实验室条件三周。
text_en: Fish were acclimated to laboratory conditions for three weeks prior to the experiment.

quote: The mean values for tested water qualities were: temperature 19 ± 2 °C, pH (7.4 ± 0.05), dissolved oxygen 6 ± 0.2 mg/L (constant aeration) and total hardness as CaCO 3 175 mg/L.
statement: 测试的水质平均值为：温度19±2°C，pH值7.4±0.05，溶解氧6±0.2 mg/L（持续曝气），总硬度以CaCO3计为175 mg/L。
text_zh: 测试的水质平均值为：温度19±2°C，pH值7.4±0.05，溶解氧6±0.2 mg/L（持续曝气），总硬度以CaCO3计为175 mg/L。
text_en: The average water quality tested was: temperature 19±2°C, pH 7.4±0.05, dissolved oxygen 6±0.2 mg/L (continuous aeration), and total hardness as CaCO3 175 mg/L.

quote: The fish were maintained in a photoperiod with 12 h light/12 h dark.
statement: 鱼类维持在12小时光照/12小时黑暗的光周期中。
text_zh: 鱼类维持在12小时光照/12小时黑暗的光周期中。
text_en: Fish were maintained in a photoperiod of 12 hours light/12 hours dark.

quote: Taking into account all our data, it appears that a dose of 2 mg silicon-based QDs per kg body weight IP injected in C. auratus gibelio caused moderate damage to renal tissue after 7 days of exposure.
statement: 对鲫鱼腹腔注射每公斤体重2毫克硅基量子点，在暴露7天后导致肾脏组织中度损伤。
text_zh: 对鲫鱼腹腔注射每公斤体重2毫克硅基量子点，在暴露7天后导致肾脏组织中度损伤。
text_en: Intraperitoneal injection of silicon-based quantum dots at 2 mg per kg body weight in crucian carp caused moderate kidney tissue damage after 7 days of exposure.

quote: The oxidative stress induced in this period of time seems to be counteracted by the crucian carp kidney, probably due to the adapted response of the antioxidant system in which Hsp 70 could play a significant role.
statement: 在此期间诱导的氧化应激似乎被鲫鱼肾脏抵消，这可能是由于抗氧化系统的适应性反应，其中Hsp 70可能发挥重要作用。
text_zh: 在此期间诱导的氧化应激似乎被鲫鱼肾脏抵消，这可能是由于抗氧化系统的适应性反应，其中Hsp 70可能发挥重要作用。
text_en: The oxidative stress induced during this period appeared to be offset by the kidney of crucian carp, possibly due to an adaptive response of the antioxidant system, in which Hsp 70 may play an important role.
outcome: 氧化应激与抗氧化反应

quote: The signs of nephroneogenesis suggest that crucian carp kidney can cope with oxidative stress under silicon-based QDs.
statement: 肾单位新生的迹象表明，在硅基量子点作用下，鲫鱼肾脏能够应对氧化应激。
text_zh: 肾单位新生的迹象表明，在硅基量子点作用下，鲫鱼肾脏能够应对氧化应激。
text_en: Signs of nephron neogenesis indicate that the kidney of crucian carp can cope with oxidative stress under the action of silicon-based quantum dots.

quote: Penelitian ini menunjuk- kan, infestasi ektoparasit A.japonicus memberikan pengaruh terhadap berku- rangnya kadar eritrosit pada ikan mas komet pada setiap tingkatan infestasi.
statement: Infestasi ektoparasit Argulus japonicus menyebabkan penurunan kadar eritrosit pada ikan mas komet di setiap tingkat infestasi.
text_en: Infestasi ektoparasit Argulus japonicus menyebabkan penurunan kadar eritrosit pada ikan mas komet di setiap tingkat infestasi.

quote: Perhitungan leukosit darah dapat diindikasikan sebagai aktivitas mekanisme sel imun pada inang (Dias, 1999).
statement: Perhitungan leukosit darah mengindikasikan aktivitas mekanisme sel imun pada inang.
text_en: Perhitungan leukosit darah mengindikasikan aktivitas mekanisme sel imun pada inang.

quote: Perubahan kadar leukosit pasca infestasi A. japonicus ter- lihat dari berkurangnya kandungan leuko- sit pada darah ikan mas komet.
statement: Pasca infestasi Argulus japonicus, terjadi pengurangan kandungan leukosit pada darah ikan mas komet.
text_en: Pasca infestasi Argulus japonicus, terjadi pengurangan kandungan leukosit pada darah ikan mas komet.

quote: Berku- rangnya kadar darah ini berbanding lurus dengan jumlah infestasi ektoparasit yang menginfestasi ikan.
statement: Pengurangan kadar leukosit berbanding lurus dengan jumlah ektoparasit yang menginfestasi ikan.
text_en: Pengurangan kadar leukosit berbanding lurus dengan jumlah ektoparasit yang menginfestasi ikan.

quote: Pemberian ektoparasit A.japonicus memberikan pengaruh yang sangat nyata terhadap jumlah sel darah putih (leukosit) dalam darah ikan mas komet.
statement: Pemberian ektoparasit Argulus japonicus berpengaruh sangat nyata terhadap jumlah leukosit dalam darah ikan mas komet.
text_en: Pemberian ektoparasit Argulus japonicus berpengaruh sangat nyata terhadap jumlah leukosit dalam darah ikan mas komet.

quote: Silicon-based quantum dots were intraperitoneally injected in Carassius auratus gibelio specimens and, over one week, the effects on renal tissue were investigated by following their distribution and histological effects, as well as antioxidative system modifications.
statement: 硅基量子点被腹腔注射到鲫鱼标本中，并在两周内通过追踪其分布、组织学效应以及抗氧化系统修饰来研究其对肾组织的影响。
text_zh: 硅基量子点被腹腔注射到鲫鱼标本中，并在两周内通过追踪其分布、组织学效应以及抗氧化系统修饰来研究其对肾组织的影响。
text_en: Silicon-based quantum dots were intraperitoneally injected into crucian carp specimens, and their effects on kidney tissue were studied over two weeks by tracking their distribution, histological effects, and antioxidant system modifications.
outcome: 肾脏组织健康与氧化应激状态

quote: After three and seven days, detached epithelial cells from the basal lamina, dilated tubules and debris in the lumen of tubules were observed.
statement: 在三天和七天后，观察到上皮细胞从基底膜脱落、肾小管扩张以及管腔内出现碎片。
text_zh: 在三天和七天后，观察到上皮细胞从基底膜脱落、肾小管扩张以及管腔内出现碎片。
text_en: At three and seven days, detachment of epithelial cells from the basement membrane, dilation of renal tubules, and appearance of debris in the lumen were observed.

quote: The reduced glutathione (GSH) concentration decreased in the first three days and started to rise later on.
statement: 还原型谷胱甘肽（GSH）浓度在前三天下降，随后开始上升。
text_zh: 还原型谷胱甘肽（GSH）浓度在前三天下降，随后开始上升。
text_en: Reduced glutathione (GSH) concentration decreased in the first three days, then began to rise.

quote: The superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity increased only after one week, whereas catalase (CAT) was up-regulated in a time-dependent manner.
statement: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性仅在一周后增加，而过氧化氢酶（CAT）呈时间依赖性上调。
text_zh: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性仅在一周后增加，而过氧化氢酶（CAT）呈时间依赖性上调。
text_en: Superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity increased only after one week, while catalase (CAT) showed a time-dependent upregulation.

quote: Oxidative modifications of proteins and the time-dependent increase of Hsp70 expression were also registered.
statement: 还记录到了蛋白质的氧化修饰以及热休克蛋白70（Hsp70）表达的时间依赖性增加。
text_zh: 还记录到了蛋白质的氧化修饰以及热休克蛋白70（Hsp70）表达的时间依赖性增加。
text_en: Oxidative modification of proteins and a time-dependent increase in heat shock protein 70 (Hsp70) expression were also recorded.
outcome: 细胞应激反应与蛋白质损伤

quote: Our data suggest that silicon-based quantum dots induced oxidative stress followed by structural damages.
statement: 我们的数据表明，硅基量子点诱导了氧化应激，随后导致结构性损伤。
text_zh: 我们的数据表明，硅基量子点诱导了氧化应激，随后导致结构性损伤。
text_en: Our data indicate that silicon-based quantum dots induced oxidative stress, subsequently leading to structural damage.
outcome: 整体健康损害（氧化应激与结构损伤）

quote: Previous studies have indicated that chemically-induced nephrotoxicosis in fish is followed by new nephron development, and tubular regeneration can be a good sign of adaptation and recovery [ 25 ].
statement: Prior research indicates that chemical-induced kidney damage in fish is followed by new nephron growth, with tubular regeneration serving as an indicator of adaptation and recovery.
text_en: Prior research indicates that chemical-induced kidney damage in fish is followed by new nephron growth, with tubular regeneration serving as an indicator of adaptation and recovery.

quote: The histological studies revealed that in addition to degenerative processes visible at 7 days after IP injection, kidney regeneration could also be observed in Carassius auratus gibelio , indicating that silicon-based QDs do not impede tissue regeneration, i.e. , nephroneogenesis.
statement: Histological analysis showed that while degeneration occurred 7 days post-injection, kidney regeneration was also present in Carassius auratus gibelio, suggesting silicon-based quantum dots do not hinder tissue regeneration or nephrogenesis.
text_en: Histological analysis showed that while degeneration occurred 7 days post-injection, kidney regeneration was also present in Carassius auratus gibelio, suggesting silicon-based quantum dots do not hinder tissue regeneration or nephrogenesis.

quote: The detection of QDs in the macrophages might explain the increased CAT and SOD activities after 3 and 7 day exposure; this could be explained by the fact that these cells, when activated, produce oxygen and nitrogen reactive species during phagocytosis [ 29 ].
statement: The presence of quantum dots in macrophages may account for elevated catalase and superoxide dismutase activities after 3 and 7 days, potentially due to the production of reactive oxygen and nitrogen species during phagocytosis by activated cells.
text_en: The presence of quantum dots in macrophages may account for elevated catalase and superoxide dismutase activities after 3 and 7 days, potentially due to the production of reactive oxygen and nitrogen species during phagocytosis by activated cells.

quote: In this study we have investigated the histological and biochemical effects of silicon-based QDs, IP injected in C. auratus gibelio over a period of 7 days.
statement: 本研究调查了硅基量子点腹腔注射到鲫鱼体内7天后的组织学和生化效应。
text_zh: 本研究调查了硅基量子点腹腔注射到鲫鱼体内7天后的组织学和生化效应。
text_en: This study investigated the histological and biochemical effects of intraperitoneal injection of silicon-based quantum dots into crucian carp after 7 days.

quote: Also, the expression of Hsp 70 continuously increased up to 7 days.
statement: 此外，Hsp 70的表达在7天内持续增加。
text_zh: 此外，Hsp 70的表达在7天内持续增加。
text_en: In addition, Hsp 70 expression continued to increase for 7 days.
outcome: 热休克蛋白表达（应激反应）

quote: Fish treatments were performed according to the Care and Use of Agricultural Animals in Agricultural Research and Teaching, approved by the Science and Technology Bureau of China.
statement: 鱼类处理遵循《农业科研和教学中农业动物的护理和使用》规定，并经中国科技局批准。
text_zh: 鱼类处理遵循《农业科研和教学中农业动物的护理和使用》规定，并经中国科技局批准。
text_en: Fish handling followed the guidelines in 'Care and Use of Agricultural Animals in Agricultural Research and Teaching' and was approved by the Chinese Bureau of Science and Technology.

quote: Fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich) before dissection.
statement: 在解剖前，使用100 mg/L的MS-222对鱼进行深度麻醉。
text_zh: 在解剖前，使用100 mg/L的MS-222对鱼进行深度麻醉。
text_en: Before dissection, fish were deeply anesthetized using 100 mg/L of MS-222.

quote: After the first day of exposure, the increase of SOD and CAT activities suggests an insignificant increase of superoxide level and its downstream metabolite, hydrogen peroxide.
statement: 暴露第一天后，SOD和CAT活性的增加表明超氧化物水平及其下游代谢产物过氧化氢的增加不显著。
text_zh: 暴露第一天后，SOD和CAT活性的增加表明超氧化物水平及其下游代谢产物过氧化氢的增加不显著。
text_en: After the first day of exposure, the increase in SOD and CAT activities indicates that the increase in superoxide levels and its downstream metabolite hydrogen peroxide was not significant.

quote: After the seventh day, SOD activity increased significantly and the dismutation of superoxide occurred.
statement: 第七天后，SOD活性显著增加，发生了超氧化物的歧化反应。
text_zh: 第七天后，SOD活性显著增加，发生了超氧化物的歧化反应。
text_en: After the seventh day, SOD activity increased significantly, and the dismutation reaction of superoxide occurred.

quote: Our results are in agreement with those of Oruc et al. (2004) who studied the SOD activity changes in kidneys of Oreochromis niloticus and Cyprinus carpio exposed to pesticides [ 43 ].
statement: 本研究结果与Oruc等人(2004)关于暴露于农药的尼罗罗非鱼和鲤鱼肾脏中SOD活性变化的研究结果一致。
text_zh: 本研究结果与Oruc等人(2004)关于暴露于农药的尼罗罗非鱼和鲤鱼肾脏中SOD活性变化的研究结果一致。
text_en: The results of this study are consistent with those of Oruc et al. (2004) on changes in SOD activity in the kidneys of Nile tilapia and carp exposed to pesticides.

quote: Nevertheless, in the presence of various doses of cadmium, a very toxic xenobiotic, this activity significantly decreased in the kidney of Clarias gariepinus [ 44 ].
statement: 然而，在存在各种剂量的镉（一种毒性很强的外源性物质）的情况下，该活性在非洲鲶鱼肾脏中显著降低。
text_zh: 然而，在存在各种剂量的镉（一种毒性很强的外源性物质）的情况下，该活性在非洲鲶鱼肾脏中显著降低。
text_en: However, in the presence of various doses of cadmium (a highly toxic exogenous substance), this activity was significantly reduced in the kidneys of African catfish.

quote: Taking into account that catalase specific activity changed by a maximum of 27% after seven days of exposure, it seems that the generation of superoxide anions was at a moderate level.
statement: 考虑到暴露七天后过氧化氢酶比活性最大变化为27%，超氧阴离子的产生似乎处于中等水平。
text_zh: 考虑到暴露七天后过氧化氢酶比活性最大变化为27%，超氧阴离子的产生似乎处于中等水平。
text_en: Considering that the maximum change in catalase specific activity was 27% after seven days of exposure, superoxide anion production appears to be at a moderate level.

quote: The activities of GR and GPX increased after one day of exposure by 14% and 16% respectively, but decreased dramatically after 3 and 7 days by approximately 50% compared to control (Figure 4).
statement: GR和GPX的活性在暴露一天后分别增加了14%和16%，但在第3天和第7天相比对照组大幅下降了约50%。
text_zh: GR和GPX的活性在暴露一天后分别增加了14%和16%，但在第3天和第7天相比对照组大幅下降了约50%。
text_en: The activities of GR and GPX increased by 14% and 16%, respectively, after one day of exposure, but decreased by about 50% compared to the control group on days 3 and 7.

quote: Additionally, the GST activity increased by 29.32%, 47.48% and 87.64% after one, 3 and 7 days of treatment, respectively (Figure 4).
statement: 此外，GST活性在处理1天、3天和7天后分别增加了29.32%、47.48%和87.64%。
text_zh: 此外，GST活性在处理1天、3天和7天后分别增加了29.32%、47.48%和87.64%。
text_en: In addition, GST activity increased by 29.32%, 47.48%, and 87.64% after 1 day, 3 days, and 7 days of treatment, respectively.

quote: After exposure, fish were stunned with a sharp blow to the head, and killed by bisection of the spinal cord and dorsal aorta, followed by cardiac ventricular tissue sampling.
statement: 鱼类在暴露后被头部重击致晕，并通过切断脊髓和背主动脉处死，随后采集心室组织。
text_zh: 鱼类在暴露后被头部重击致晕，并通过切断脊髓和背主动脉处死，随后采集心室组织。
text_en: Fish were stunned by a blow to the head after exposure, and killed by severing the spinal cord and dorsal aorta, followed by collection of ventricular tissue.

quote: Two similar exposure series were conducted: one at 13 °C and one at 8 °C. Each series contained the following four groups (n = 8 in all groups): Normoxic controls at 8°C (8N7) and at 13°C (13N7). One day anoxia at 8°C (8A1) and at 13°C (13A1). Seven days anoxia at 8°C (8A7) and at 13°C (13A7). Seven days anoxia followed by seven days of re-oxygenation at 8°C (8R7) and at 13°C (13R7).
statement: 研究在13°C和8°C下进行了两组类似的暴露实验，每组包含常氧对照、1天缺氧、7天缺氧以及7天缺氧后复氧四个组别。
text_zh: 研究在13°C和8°C下进行了两组类似的暴露实验，每组包含常氧对照、1天缺氧、7天缺氧以及7天缺氧后复氧四个组别。
text_en: The study conducted two similar exposure experiments at 13°C and 8°C, each consisting of four groups: normoxic control, 1-day hypoxia, 7-day hypoxia, and reoxygenation after 7 days of hypoxia.

quote: At longer exposure times, this enzyme was not efficient in both hydrogen peroxide as well as lipid detoxification of peroxidation products.
statement: 在较长的暴露时间下，该酶在过氧化氢分解及脂质过氧化产物的解毒方面效率低下。
text_zh: 在较长的暴露时间下，该酶在过氧化氢分解及脂质过氧化产物的解毒方面效率低下。
text_en: Under longer exposure times, this enzyme is inefficient in decomposing hydrogen peroxide and detoxifying lipid peroxidation products.

quote: The specific activity of G6PDH increased significantly by 49% and 94% after 3 and 7 days of treatment, respectively, compared to controls (Figure 4).
statement: 与对照组相比，处理3天和7天后G6PDH的比活性分别显著增加了49%和94%。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，处理3天和7天后G6PDH的比活性分别显著增加了49%和94%。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the specific activity of G6PDH increased significantly by 49% and 94% after 3 days and 7 days of treatment, respectively.

quote: We hypothesized that the overall transcriptional effect of anoxia would be smaller at 8°C than at 13°C and that a reduction in temperature alone might result in preconditioning of the crucian carp heart for exposure to anoxia.
statement: 作者假设缺氧的整体转录效应在8°C时比13°C时小，且仅降低温度可能使鲫鱼心脏对缺氧暴露产生预适应。
text_zh: 作者假设缺氧的整体转录效应在8°C时比13°C时小，且仅降低温度可能使鲫鱼心脏对缺氧暴露产生预适应。
text_en: The authors hypothesize that the overall transcriptional effect of hypoxia is smaller at 8°C than at 13°C, and that lowering the temperature alone may pre-adapt crucian carp hearts to hypoxia exposure.
outcome: 心脏对缺氧的适应性/应激反应

quote: Most of the anoxia-induced changes were restored upon re-oxygenation (Figure 4A–C).
statement: 大多数由缺氧引起的变化在复氧后得到恢复。
text_zh: 大多数由缺氧引起的变化在复氧后得到恢复。
text_en: Most of the changes caused by hypoxia were restored after reoxygenation.

quote: while the hearts of zebrafish (Danio rerio) held under chronic hypoxia (10% of air saturation for 21 days) displayed a shift towards anaerobic metabolism in gene expression profile [19]
statement: 在慢性缺氧（空气饱和度的10%，持续21天）条件下饲养的斑马鱼心脏，其基因表达谱显示出向厌氧代谢的转变。
text_zh: 在慢性缺氧（空气饱和度的10%，持续21天）条件下饲养的斑马鱼心脏，其基因表达谱显示出向厌氧代谢的转变。
text_en: Zebrafish hearts reared under chronic hypoxia (10% air saturation for 21 days) showed a shift in gene expression profiles towards anaerobic metabolism.
outcome: 代谢模式改变/基因表达

quote: At 8°C, the transition of crucian carp from normoxia to anoxia (i.e. 8A1, 8A7) followed by reoxygenation (8R7) was linked to very few or no DE genes.
statement: 在8°C条件下，鲫鱼从常氧到缺氧再复氧的过渡与极少或没有差异表达基因相关。
text_zh: 在8°C条件下，鲫鱼从常氧到缺氧再复氧的过渡与极少或没有差异表达基因相关。
text_en: Under conditions of 8°C, the transition from normoxia to hypoxia and then reoxygenation in crucian carp was associated with very few or no differentially expressed genes.

quote: Panel C shows that the anoxic response (A7/A1 contrast) was inversely correlated with the subsequent reoxygenation response (R7/A7 contrast).
statement: 缺氧反应与随后的复氧反应呈负相关。
text_zh: 缺氧反应与随后的复氧反应呈负相关。
text_en: The hypoxia response is negatively correlated with the subsequent reoxygenation response.

quote: At 8°C, using a false discovery rate of 5%, neither anoxia nor re-oxygenation elicited appreciable changes in gene expression.
statement: 在8°C时，缺氧或复氧均未引起明显的基因表达变化。
text_zh: 在8°C时，缺氧或复氧均未引起明显的基因表达变化。
text_en: At 8°C, neither hypoxia nor reoxygenation caused significant changes in gene expression.

quote: Re-oxygenation for 7 days was sufficient to completely reverse these responses.
statement: 复氧7天足以完全逆转这些反应。
text_zh: 复氧7天足以完全逆转这些反应。
text_en: 7 days of reoxygenation is sufficient to completely reverse these responses.

quote: The stress-related category of genes included two cold-inducible RNA binding proteins, hypoxia up-regulated protein, four heat shock proteins and two chaperones, and two genes involved in oxygen metabolism.
statement: 与应激相关的基因类别包括冷诱导RNA结合蛋白、缺氧上调蛋白、热休克蛋白、伴侣蛋白以及参与氧代谢的基因。
text_zh: 与应激相关的基因类别包括冷诱导RNA结合蛋白、缺氧上调蛋白、热休克蛋白、伴侣蛋白以及参与氧代谢的基因。
text_en: Gene categories associated with stress include cold-inducible RNA-binding protein, hypoxia-upregulated protein, heat shock protein, chaperone, and genes involved in oxygen metabolism.

quote: We also saw a reduction in calmodulin (CALM) and in ryanodine receptors (RYR), and increases for the plasma membrane Ca 2+ ATPase (PMCA) and calcium-transporting ATPase type 2C member 1 (ATP2C1).
statement: 观察到钙调蛋白和兰尼碱受体减少，而质膜Ca2+ ATP酶和钙转运ATP酶2C成员1增加。
text_zh: 观察到钙调蛋白和兰尼碱受体减少，而质膜Ca2+ ATP酶和钙转运ATP酶2C成员1增加。
text_en: Calmodulin and ryanodine receptors were observed to decrease, while plasma membrane Ca2+ ATPase and calcium transport ATPase 2C member 1 increased.

quote: NLRP3 was upregulated, indicating activation of the innate immune system [63] .
statement: NLRP3表达上调，表明先天免疫系统被激活。
text_zh: NLRP3表达上调，表明先天免疫系统被激活。
text_en: Upregulation of NLRP3 expression indicates that the innate immune system is activated.

quote: Importantly, these predominant anoxia-induced transcriptional responses were entirely reversed when normoxia had been re-established, revealing reversibility and indicating that the changes seen in anoxia are of adaptive and protective nature.
statement: 当恢复正常氧气水平时，主要的缺氧诱导转录反应完全逆转，这表明这些变化具有可逆性，且属于适应性和保护性性质。
text_zh: 当恢复正常氧气水平时，主要的缺氧诱导转录反应完全逆转，这表明这些变化具有可逆性，且属于适应性和保护性性质。
text_en: When normal oxygen levels are restored, the major hypoxia-induced transcriptional response is completely reversed, indicating that these changes are reversible and of an adaptive and protective nature.

quote: First, all glycolytic genes displayed a small but consistently up-regulated transcript abundance relative to the control after one day of anoxia, and after seven days of reoxygenation.
statement: 在缺氧一天后以及复氧七天后，所有糖酵解基因的转录丰度相对于对照组均表现出小幅但一致的上调。
text_zh: 在缺氧一天后以及复氧七天后，所有糖酵解基因的转录丰度相对于对照组均表现出小幅但一致的上调。
text_en: After one day of hypoxia and seven days of reoxygenation, the transcriptional abundance of all glycolytic genes showed a small but consistent upregulation relative to the control group.

quote: However, responses following the intervening seven days of anoxia varied; five genes were up-regulated, including hexokinase and phosphofructokinase [48] , and two isoforms of enolase, which is an equilibrium enzyme.
statement: 然而，在随后的七天缺氧期间，反应各不相同；五个基因上调，包括己糖激酶、磷酸果糖激酶以及两种烯醇化酶异构体。
text_zh: 然而，在随后的七天缺氧期间，反应各不相同；五个基因上调，包括己糖激酶、磷酸果糖激酶以及两种烯醇化酶异构体。
text_en: However, during the subsequent seven-day hypoxia period, responses varied; five genes were upregulated, including hexokinase, phosphofructokinase, and two enolase isoforms.

quote: Transcripts from genes linked to NFkB pathways were also significantly changed, including an increase in connective tissue growth factor (CTGF) and fibroblast growth factor 1 (FGF1).
statement: 与NFkB通路相关的基因转录本发生显著变化，包括结缔组织生长因子（CTGF）和成纤维细胞生长因子1（FGF1）的增加。
text_zh: 与NFkB通路相关的基因转录本发生显著变化，包括结缔组织生长因子（CTGF）和成纤维细胞生长因子1（FGF1）的增加。
text_en: Transcripts of genes associated with the NFkB pathway changed significantly, including increases in connective tissue growth factor (CTGF) and fibroblast growth factor 1 (FGF1).

quote: Although both 8 and 13°C groups were held on a 12 hours light/12 hours dark cycle, we cannot exclude more subtle seasonally entrained influences, such as those linked to photoperiod, reproductive cycles or reduced appetite etc., which might modify responses.
statement: 虽然8°C和13°C组均保持在12小时光照/12小时黑暗周期下，但我们不能排除更细微的季节性同步影响，如与光周期、生殖周期或食欲减退等相关的影响，这些可能会改变反应。
text_zh: 虽然8°C和13°C组均保持在12小时光照/12小时黑暗周期下，但我们不能排除更细微的季节性同步影响，如与光周期、生殖周期或食欲减退等相关的影响，这些可能会改变反应。
text_en: Although both the 8°C and 13°C groups were maintained under a 12-hour light/12-hour dark cycle, we cannot exclude more subtle seasonal synchronization effects, such as those related to photoperiod, reproductive cycles, or appetite reduction, which may alter the response.
limitations: 无法排除季节性同步影响

quote: It follows that the main features of the transcriptomic response to anoxia were conserved at both temperatures, but the magnitude of response was temperature-dependent either due to direct thermal effects or perhaps due to the greater energetic demand of tissues at 13 compared to 8°C.
statement: 由此可知，对缺氧的转录组反应的主要特征在两种温度下是保守的，但反应的幅度是温度依赖性的，这可能是由于直接的热效应，或者可能是由于13°C相比8°C组织具有更大的能量需求。
text_zh: 由此可知，对缺氧的转录组反应的主要特征在两种温度下是保守的，但反应的幅度是温度依赖性的，这可能是由于直接的热效应，或者可能是由于13°C相比8°C组织具有更大的能量需求。
text_en: From this, it can be seen that the main features of the transcriptomic response to hypoxia are conserved at both temperatures, but the magnitude of the response is temperature-dependent, which may be due to direct thermal effects, or possibly due to greater energy demands in tissues at 13°C compared to 8°C.

quote: It is a hypoxia-tolerant species but is relative sensitive to high nitrite and pH levels.
statement: 该物种耐低氧，但对高亚硝酸盐和pH水平相对敏感。
text_zh: 该物种耐低氧，但对高亚硝酸盐和pH水平相对敏感。
text_en: This species is tolerant of low oxygen, but relatively sensitive to high nitrite and pH levels.

quote: They were transferred to and maintained in 750 litre tanks continuously supplied with de-chlorinated, aerated Oslo tap water at ambient temperatures, with a 12 h/12 h photoperiod and ad libitum feeding with a commercial carp food.
statement: 鱼被转移并维持在750升水箱中，持续供应去氯、充气的奥斯陆自来水，处于环境温度下，光照周期为12小时/12小时，并自由采食商业鲤鱼饲料。
text_zh: 鱼被转移并维持在750升水箱中，持续供应去氯、充气的奥斯陆自来水，处于环境温度下，光照周期为12小时/12小时，并自由采食商业鲤鱼饲料。
text_en: Fish were transferred and maintained in 750-liter tanks, with a continuous supply of dechlorinated, aerated Oslo tap water, at ambient temperature, under a 12-hour/12-hour light cycle, and fed commercial carp feed ad libitum.

quote: Fish were held at these temperatures for at least two weeks before the experiments were conducted.
statement: 在进行实验前，鱼在这些温度下至少保持两周。
text_zh: 在进行实验前，鱼在这些温度下至少保持两周。
text_en: Before the experiment, the fish were kept at these temperatures for at least two weeks.

quote: Fish were conditioned to the tank for 24 hours prior to anoxic exposure.
statement: 在缺氧暴露前，鱼在水箱中适应24小时。
text_zh: 在缺氧暴露前，鱼在水箱中适应24小时。
text_en: Before hypoxia exposure, the fish were acclimated in tanks for 24 hours.

quote: Anoxia (2 /L) was obtained by bubbling the incoming water with nitrogen in a 1.5 m Plexiglas column (or with air during reoxygenation).
statement: 通过在1.5米有机玻璃柱中用氮气吹入进水来获得缺氧状态（复氧期间则用空气）。
text_zh: 通过在1.5米有机玻璃柱中用氮气吹入进水来获得缺氧状态（复氧期间则用空气）。
text_en: Hypoxic conditions were obtained by bubbling nitrogen into the influent water in a 1.5-meter organic glass column (air was used during reoxygenation).

quote: Oxygen concentrations and temperatures were continuously monitored with a galvanometric oxygen electrode, Oxi 323 (WTW, Weilheim, Germany).
statement: 使用电流计式氧电极Oxi 323连续监测氧气浓度和温度。
text_zh: 使用电流计式氧电极Oxi 323连续监测氧气浓度和温度。
text_en: Oxygen concentration and temperature were continuously monitored using a galvanometric oxygen electrode Oxi 323.

quote: Fish were fed 1% of their body weight daily, using the same feed as during holding.
statement: 鱼类每天按体重的1%进行投喂，使用与暂养期间相同的饲料。
text_zh: 鱼类每天按体重的1%进行投喂，使用与暂养期间相同的饲料。
text_en: Fish were fed daily at 1% of body weight, using the same feed as during the holding period.

quote: Any regurgitated pellets were counted and, in each case, were determined to be negligible relative to the size of the meal.
statement: 对反吐的颗粒进行了计数，在每种情况下，相对于餐量大小均被确定为可忽略不计。
text_zh: 对反吐的颗粒进行了计数，在每种情况下，相对于餐量大小均被确定为可忽略不计。
text_en: Regurgitated pellets were counted and, in each case, were determined to be negligible relative to meal size.

quote: Thirty minutes after feeding, the fish was replaced into their chamber and monitored for a further 24 h.
statement: 喂食后30分钟，将鱼放回其测量室并继续监测24小时。
text_zh: 喂食后30分钟，将鱼放回其测量室并继续监测24小时。
text_en: 30 minutes after feeding, the fish were returned to their measurement chamber and monitoring continued for 24 hours.

quote: MMR was measured after an exhaustive chase protocol, MO 2 was measured for 9 min, and MMR was taken as the steepest three min slope during this time.
statement: 最大耗氧量（MMR）是在耗尽性追逐方案后测得的，MO2测量了9分钟，MMR取该时间段内最陡的3分钟斜率。
text_zh: 最大耗氧量（MMR）是在耗尽性追逐方案后测得的，MO2测量了9分钟，MMR取该时间段内最陡的3分钟斜率。
text_en: Maximum metabolic rate (MMR) was measured after an exhaustive chase protocol; MO2 was measured for 9 minutes, and MMR was taken as the steepest 3-minute slope within that period.

quote: The results showed that the standard metabolic rate (SMR) was positively correlated with ammonia, nitrite, and pH, while the maximum metabolic rate (MMR) was negatively correlated with all four stressors.
statement: 研究结果显示，标准代谢率（SMR）与氨氮、亚硝酸盐和pH值呈正相关，而最大代谢率（MMR）与所有四种胁迫因子呈负相关。
text_zh: 研究结果显示，标准代谢率（SMR）与氨氮、亚硝酸盐和pH值呈正相关，而最大代谢率（MMR）与所有四种胁迫因子呈负相关。
text_en: The study results showed that standard metabolic rate (SMR) was positively correlated with ammonia nitrogen, nitrite, and pH, while maximum metabolic rate (MMR) was negatively correlated with all four stress factors.

quote: Thus, aerobic scope (AS) was reduced when C. auratus gibelio was exposed to high ammonia, high nitrite, high pH, and hypoxia.
statement: 因此，当吉氏鲫暴露于高氨氮、高亚硝酸盐、高pH值和缺氧条件下时，其有氧范围（AS）降低。
text_zh: 因此，当吉氏鲫暴露于高氨氮、高亚硝酸盐、高pH值和缺氧条件下时，其有氧范围（AS）降低。
text_en: Therefore, when Carassius gibelio is exposed to high ammonia nitrogen, high nitrite, high pH, and hypoxia conditions, its aerobic scope (AS) decreases.

quote: The peak of post-prandial O 2 consumption was positively correlated with nitrite, pH, and the occurrence of the peak metabolic rate post-prandial was delayed in high ammonia, high nitrite, hypoxia, and high pH conditions.
statement: 餐后耗氧峰值与亚硝酸盐和pH值呈正相关，且在高氨氮、高亚硝酸盐、缺氧和高pH条件下，餐后代谢率峰值的出现时间延迟。
text_zh: 餐后耗氧峰值与亚硝酸盐和pH值呈正相关，且在高氨氮、高亚硝酸盐、缺氧和高pH条件下，餐后代谢率峰值的出现时间延迟。
text_en: The postprandial peak oxygen consumption is positively correlated with nitrite and pH, and under conditions of high ammonia nitrogen, high nitrite, hypoxia, and high pH, the time to reach the peak postprandial metabolic rate is delayed.

quote: With more energy required to maintain standard metabolic rates, less will be available for growth.
statement: 由于维持标准代谢率需要更多能量，可用于生长的能量将减少。
text_zh: 由于维持标准代谢率需要更多能量，可用于生长的能量将减少。
text_en: Because more energy is required to maintain standard metabolic rate, less energy will be available for growth.

quote: While the C. auratus gibelio is one of the most hypoxia tolerance species, the reduction we observed in AS caused by stressors that commonly occur in ponds and in nature will likely affect growth in ponds and fitness in nature.
statement: 虽然吉氏鲫是耐缺氧能力最强的物种之一，但我们观察到的由池塘和自然环境中常见胁迫因子引起的有氧范围降低，可能会影响其在池塘中的生长和在自然环境中的适应性。
text_zh: 虽然吉氏鲫是耐缺氧能力最强的物种之一，但我们观察到的由池塘和自然环境中常见胁迫因子引起的有氧范围降低，可能会影响其在池塘中的生长和在自然环境中的适应性。
text_en: Although Carassius gibelio is one of the species with the strongest tolerance to hypoxia, the reduction in aerobic scope we observed, caused by common stressors in ponds and natural environments, may affect its growth in ponds and adaptability in natural environments.

quote: SMR of C. auratus gibelio increased significantly with increasing ambient ammonia
statement: 高氨暴露导致银鲫标准代谢率显著增加。
text_zh: 高氨暴露导致银鲫标准代谢率显著增加。
text_en: High ammonia exposure significantly increased the standard metabolic rate of gibel carp.

quote: MMR decreased significantly with increasing ambient ammonia
statement: 随着环境氨浓度增加，最大代谢率显著下降。
text_zh: 随着环境氨浓度增加，最大代谢率显著下降。
text_en: As environmental ammonia concentration increases, maximum metabolic rate significantly decreases.

quote: AS decreased significantly with increasing ambient ammonia
statement: 随着环境氨浓度增加，有氧范围显著下降。
text_zh: 随着环境氨浓度增加，有氧范围显著下降。
text_en: As environmental ammonia concentration increases, the aerobic scope significantly decreases.

quote: The time to peak post-prandial MO 2 was delayed with increasing ambient ammonia
statement: 随着环境氨浓度增加，餐后耗氧量达到峰值的时间延迟。
text_zh: 随着环境氨浓度增加，餐后耗氧量达到峰值的时间延迟。
text_en: As environmental ammonia concentration increases, the time to reach peak postprandial oxygen consumption is delayed.

quote: Each chamber (2 L) was equipped with a recirculation pump that only turned on when the inflow water was turned off for a measurement to ensure sufficient water mixing and minimize intermittent disturbance to the fish.
statement: Recirculation pumps were used intermittently to ensure mixing while minimizing disturbance to the fish during measurements.
text_en: Recirculation pumps were used intermittently to ensure mixing while minimizing disturbance to the fish during measurements.

quote: experimentally manipulated fish were exposed to high-ammonia water (0.5, 1.0, and 2.0 mg L −1), high-nitrite water (0.5, 1.0, and 1.5 mg L −1), hypoxic water (4.0 and 1.5 mg L −1 , and 8.0 mg L −1 as a control), and high pH water (9.1, 9.5, and 9.9).
statement: Fish were exposed to varying levels of ammonia, nitrite, dissolved oxygen, and pH in experimental treatments.
text_en: Fish were exposed to varying levels of ammonia, nitrite, dissolved oxygen, and pH in experimental treatments.

quote: Ammonia was adjusted by adding ammonium chloride, nitrite was adjusted by adding sodium nitrite, DO was controlled by mixing nitrogen and oxygen, and alkaline (high pH) water was prepared by adding sodium carbonate and sodium bicarbonate (total alkalinity was 30.0 m mol L −1).
statement: Specific chemicals and gas mixtures were used to adjust water quality parameters such as ammonia, nitrite, dissolved oxygen, and pH.
text_en: Specific chemicals and gas mixtures were used to adjust water quality parameters such as ammonia, nitrite, dissolved oxygen, and pH.

quote: After an acclimation period (24 h), and oxygen consumption was measured every hour throughout a 96 h experimental period in each chamber (fish was put in the chamber singular).
statement: Fish underwent a 24-hour acclimation period before hourly oxygen consumption measurements over 96 hours in individual chambers.
text_en: Fish underwent a 24-hour acclimation period before hourly oxygen consumption measurements over 96 hours in individual chambers.

quote: its aerobic metabolism in response to high ammonia, nitrite, pH, and hypoxia were evaluated during acute exposure.
statement: Aerobic metabolism was evaluated in response to acute exposure to high ammonia, nitrite, pH, and hypoxia.
text_en: Aerobic metabolism was evaluated in response to acute exposure to high ammonia, nitrite, pH, and hypoxia.

quote: C. auratus gibelio were acclimatized for 2 weeks in 300 L tanks at 26.0 ± 1 °C before experiments.
statement: Fish were acclimatized for 2 weeks in 300 L tanks at 26.0 ± 1 °C prior to experiments.
text_en: Fish were acclimatized for 2 weeks in 300 L tanks at 26.0 ± 1 °C prior to experiments.

quote: During this period, the fish were fed daily using commercial pellets.
statement: Fish were fed daily with commercial pellets during the acclimatization period.
text_en: Fish were fed daily with commercial pellets during the acclimatization period.

quote: Ammonia, nitrate, and pH levels were monitored and 1/3 of the water was changed every day.
statement: Water quality parameters were monitored and one-third of the water was exchanged daily.
text_en: Water quality parameters were monitored and one-third of the water was exchanged daily.

quote: Prior to the experiment, fish underwent a fasting period of 48 h, enough to ensure that they were in a post-absorptive state.
statement: Fish underwent a 48-hour fasting period to ensure a post-absorptive state before the experiment.
text_en: Fish underwent a 48-hour fasting period to ensure a post-absorptive state before the experiment.

quote: Nitrite is one of the most common toxic nitrogenous compounds in aquaculture systems, it can accumulate during intensive aquaculture due to the excessive use of proteinaceous feed, higher stocking densities, and/or imbalances between bacterial nitrification and denitrification.
statement: 亚硝酸盐是水产养殖系统中常见的有毒含氮化合物，在集约化养殖期间，由于过量使用蛋白质饲料、较高的放养密度和/或细菌硝化与反硝化之间的不平衡，它可能会积累。
text_zh: 亚硝酸盐是水产养殖系统中常见的有毒含氮化合物，在集约化养殖期间，由于过量使用蛋白质饲料、较高的放养密度和/或细菌硝化与反硝化之间的不平衡，它可能会积累。
text_en: Nitrite is a common toxic nitrogenous compound in aquaculture systems, and it may accumulate during intensive farming due to excessive use of protein feed, high stocking density, and/or an imbalance between bacterial nitrification and denitrification.

quote: Elevated concentrations of nitrite can be toxic to aquatic animals, acting by mechanisms that have been investigated in various freshwater species, showing that elevated concentrations of nitrite in pond water can affect growth, molting, immune response [ 8 ], and ammonia excretion [ 9 , 10 ].
statement: 升高的亚硝酸盐浓度对水生动物具有毒性，其在池塘水中的升高会影响生长、蜕壳、免疫反应和氨排泄。
text_zh: 升高的亚硝酸盐浓度对水生动物具有毒性，其在池塘水中的升高会影响生长、蜕壳、免疫反应和氨排泄。
text_en: Elevated nitrite concentrations are toxic to aquatic animals, and their increase in pond water affects growth, molting, immune response, and ammonia excretion.
outcome: 生长、蜕壳、免疫反应、氨排泄

quote: Dissolved oxygen (DO) is the primary limiting factor that dominates ectotherm physiology and behavior in aquatic ecosystems. DO regularly shows large fluctuations within the aquatic environment, especially in high density aquaculture.
statement: 溶解氧（DO）是主导水生生态系统中变温动物生理和行为的主要限制因素，尤其在高密度水产养殖中，DO经常表现出大幅波动。
text_zh: 溶解氧（DO）是主导水生生态系统中变温动物生理和行为的主要限制因素，尤其在高密度水产养殖中，DO经常表现出大幅波动。
text_en: Dissolved oxygen (DO) is the main limiting factor governing the physiology and behavior of ectotherms in aquatic ecosystems, especially in high-density aquaculture, where DO often exhibits large fluctuations.

quote: Hypoxia can result in reduced food consumption, slowed growth rates, reduced fecundity, or even death [ 11 , 12 , 13 ].
statement: 缺氧会导致摄食量减少、生长速度减慢、繁殖力降低甚至死亡。
text_zh: 缺氧会导致摄食量减少、生长速度减慢、繁殖力降低甚至死亡。
text_en: Hypoxia leads to reduced feed intake, slowed growth rate, decreased fecundity, and even death.
outcome: 摄食、生长、繁殖力、死亡率

quote: High pH water can cause immediate, dramatic inhibition of ammonia excretion and a subsequent increase in plasma ammonia [ 4 , 14 ], which is potentially lethal.
statement: 高pH值的水会导致氨排泄立即且显著地受到抑制，随后血浆氨增加，这具有潜在致命性。
text_zh: 高pH值的水会导致氨排泄立即且显著地受到抑制，随后血浆氨增加，这具有潜在致命性。
text_en: High pH water causes immediate and significant inhibition of ammonia excretion, followed by an increase in plasma ammonia, which is potentially lethal.
outcome: 氨排泄、血浆氨水平、生存率

quote: SMR of C. auratus gibelio increased significantly with increasing ambient nitrite
statement: 高亚硝酸盐暴露导致吉氏鲫的标准代谢率显著增加。
text_zh: 高亚硝酸盐暴露导致吉氏鲫的标准代谢率显著增加。
text_en: High nitrite exposure significantly increased the standard metabolic rate of Carassius gibelio.

quote: MMR decreased significantly with increasing ambient nitrite
statement: 随着环境亚硝酸盐浓度增加，最大代谢率显著下降。
text_zh: 随着环境亚硝酸盐浓度增加，最大代谢率显著下降。
text_en: As environmental nitrite concentration increases, maximum metabolic rate significantly decreases.

quote: Peak post-prandial MO 2 increased with increasing ambient nitrite (P 2 was delayed with increasing ambient nitrite (Figure 2 b).
statement: 随着环境亚硝酸盐浓度的增加，餐后峰值耗氧量增加，且达到峰值的时间延迟。
text_zh: 随着环境亚硝酸盐浓度的增加，餐后峰值耗氧量增加，且达到峰值的时间延迟。
text_en: As environmental nitrite concentration increases, postprandial peak oxygen consumption rate increases, and the time to reach the peak is delayed.

quote: was delayed with increasing ambient nitrite (Figure 2 b)
statement: 餐后耗氧量的峰值出现时间随环境亚硝酸盐浓度增加而延迟。
text_zh: 餐后耗氧量的峰值出现时间随环境亚硝酸盐浓度增加而延迟。
text_en: The time to peak postprandial oxygen consumption is delayed as environmental nitrite concentration increases.

quote: When too high or too low, ammonia, nitrite, pH, and oxygen can become stressors for aquatic animals in traditional pond aquaculture and natural water bodies.
statement: 氨、亚硝酸盐、pH值和氧气过高或过低时，会成为传统池塘养殖和自然水体中水生动物的应激源。
text_zh: 氨、亚硝酸盐、pH值和氧气过高或过低时，会成为传统池塘养殖和自然水体中水生动物的应激源。
text_en: When ammonia, nitrite, pH, and oxygen are too high or too low, they become stressors for aquatic animals in traditional pond farming and natural water bodies.

population.system: traditional pond aquaculture and natural water bodies

quote: Physiological activities of fish are susceptible to physical and chemical environmental stressors, which can be reflected by changes in metabolic activity [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ].
statement: 鱼类的生理活动易受物理和化学环境应激的影响，这可以通过代谢活动的变化来反映。
text_zh: 鱼类的生理活动易受物理和化学环境应激的影响，这可以通过代谢活动的变化来反映。
text_en: The physiological activities of fish are easily affected by physical and chemical environmental stress, which can be reflected by changes in metabolic activity.

quote: In feed-based aquaculture, only 20% to 40% of the nitrogen in the protein of feed used in aquaculture ponds is recovered in harvest biomass. The other 60% to 80% remains in the water as uneaten feed, or is deposited as feces or excreted as ammonia nitrogen by aquatic animals [ 5 ].
statement: 在饲料养殖中，养殖池中饲料蛋白氮仅有20%至40%被回收至收获生物量中，其余60%至80%以未食用饲料形式留在水中，或以粪便沉积或由水生动物排泄为氨氮。
text_zh: 在饲料养殖中，养殖池中饲料蛋白氮仅有20%至40%被回收至收获生物量中，其余60%至80%以未食用饲料形式留在水中，或以粪便沉积或由水生动物排泄为氨氮。
text_en: In feed-based aquaculture, only 20% to 40% of the dietary protein nitrogen in culture ponds is recovered into harvested biomass; the remaining 60% to 80% remains in the water as uneaten feed, or is deposited as feces or excreted as ammonia nitrogen by aquatic animals.

quote: While fish can excrete ammonia as NH 3 across gill membranes into water [ 6 ], high environmental ammonia reduces the outward flux of ammonia through the gills. As a result, blood and tissue ammonia levels can increase and fish can experience both the chronic and acute effects of ammonia toxicity [ 7 ].
statement: 虽然鱼类可以通过鳃膜将氨以NH3形式排入水中，但高环境氨会减少通过鳃的氨外流。结果导致血液和组织中的氨水平升高，鱼类可能经历氨毒性的慢性和急性影响。
text_zh: 虽然鱼类可以通过鳃膜将氨以NH3形式排入水中，但高环境氨会减少通过鳃的氨外流。结果导致血液和组织中的氨水平升高，鱼类可能经历氨毒性的慢性和急性影响。
text_en: Although fish can excrete ammonia into the water as NH3 through their gill membranes, high environmental ammonia reduces ammonia efflux through the gills. This results in elevated ammonia levels in the blood and tissues, and fish may experience chronic and acute effects of ammonia toxicity.

quote: Dissolved oxygen (DO) was monitored every second using an oxygen meter (YSI 6600, measuring precision is 0.01 mg L −1), and the oxygen probe was calibrated before each experiment.
statement: 溶解氧使用氧气计每秒监测一次，且氧气探头在每次实验前进行校准。
text_zh: 溶解氧使用氧气计每秒监测一次，且氧气探头在每次实验前进行校准。
text_en: Dissolved oxygen was monitored once per second using an oxygen meter, and the oxygen probe was calibrated before each experiment.

quote: The fish appeared to be in excellent condition and remained quiet while measurements were made in the dark.
statement: 在黑暗环境中进行测量时，鱼看起来状况良好并保持安静。
text_zh: 在黑暗环境中进行测量时，鱼看起来状况良好并保持安静。
text_en: When measured in a dark environment, the fish appeared to be in good condition and remained quiet.

quote: MMR was measured using an exhaustive chase protocol, where the experimenter manually chased the fish to exhaustion (5 min).
statement: 最大代谢率通过力竭追逐方案测量，实验者手动追逐鱼直至力竭（5分钟）。
text_zh: 最大代谢率通过力竭追逐方案测量，实验者手动追逐鱼直至力竭（5分钟）。
text_en: Maximum metabolic rate was measured via an exhaustive chase protocol, where experimenters manually chased fish until exhaustion (5 minutes).

quote: All individuals were visibly exhausted by the end of the 5 min exercise period as highlighted by a lack of response to an experimenter tapping the caudal fin.
statement: 所有个体在5分钟运动期结束时明显力竭，表现为对实验者轻拍尾鳍无反应。
text_zh: 所有个体在5分钟运动期结束时明显力竭，表现为对实验者轻拍尾鳍无反应。
text_en: All individuals were clearly exhausted at the end of the 5-minute exercise period, showing no response to light tapping of the tail fin by the experimenter.

quote: This was followed by a period of exposure to air (approximately 1 min), with the goal of completely exhausting the fish.
statement: 随后是约1分钟的空气暴露期，目的是使鱼完全力竭。
text_zh: 随后是约1分钟的空气暴露期，目的是使鱼完全力竭。
text_en: This was followed by an air exposure period of about 1 minute, intended to exhaust the fish completely.

quote: Once MMR had been determined for each fish, the respirometers were set to the automated flush cycles outlined above and MO 2 was measured for at least 6 h while the fish recovered.
statement: 确定每条鱼的MMR后，呼吸仪设置为自动冲洗循环，并在鱼恢复期间至少测量6小时的耗氧量。
text_zh: 确定每条鱼的MMR后，呼吸仪设置为自动冲洗循环，并在鱼恢复期间至少测量6小时的耗氧量。
text_en: After determining the MMR for each fish, the respirometer was set to an automatic flushing cycle, and oxygen consumption was measured for at least 6 hours during the recovery period of the fish.

quote: High nitrite impaired the aerobic metabolism of C. auratus gibelio , which may translate to reduced locomotion and growth because of the increased SMR and decreased MMR, meanwhile, peak post-prandial MO 2 and time-to-peak post-prandial MO 2 both increased.
statement: 高亚硝酸盐损害了银鲫的有氧代谢，这可能导致运动能力和生长减少，因为标准代谢率增加且最大代谢率降低，同时餐后耗氧量的峰值和达到峰值的时间均增加。
text_zh: 高亚硝酸盐损害了银鲫的有氧代谢，这可能导致运动能力和生长减少，因为标准代谢率增加且最大代谢率降低，同时餐后耗氧量的峰值和达到峰值的时间均增加。
text_en: High nitrite impaired aerobic metabolism in gibel carp, which may lead to reduced swimming performance and growth because standard metabolic rate increased and maximum metabolic rate decreased, while both the peak and time to peak of postprandial oxygen consumption increased.

quote: The increase of peak post-prandial MO 2 and time-to-peak post-prandial MO 2 were consistent with low feeding rate and food conversion efficiency [ 25 ].
statement: 餐后耗氧量峰值及其达峰时间的增加与低摄食率和食物转化效率一致。
text_zh: 餐后耗氧量峰值及其达峰时间的增加与低摄食率和食物转化效率一致。
text_en: The increase in peak postprandial oxygen consumption and the time to reach this peak is consistent with low feeding rates and food conversion efficiency.

quote: When metabolism increases while the AS is narrower, the fish becomes more sensitive to hypoxia during digestion and may reduce ingestion.
statement: 当代谢增加而活动范围变窄时，鱼类在消化过程中对缺氧更加敏感，并可能减少摄入。
text_zh: 当代谢增加而活动范围变窄时，鱼类在消化过程中对缺氧更加敏感，并可能减少摄入。
text_en: When metabolism increases and the activity range narrows, fish become more sensitive to hypoxia during digestion and may reduce intake.

quote: One physiological response to nitrite is an increase in methemoglobin. The hemoglobin becomes oxidized and unable to bind and carry molecules of oxygen [ 26 ].
statement: 对亚硝酸盐的一种生理反应是高铁血红蛋白的增加。血红蛋白被氧化，无法结合和携带氧气分子。
text_zh: 对亚硝酸盐的一种生理反应是高铁血红蛋白的增加。血红蛋白被氧化，无法结合和携带氧气分子。
text_en: One physiological response to nitrite is an increase in methemoglobin. Hemoglobin is oxidized and unable to bind and carry oxygen molecules.

quote: In this case, the increased SMR in C. auratus gibelio was a result of either the induction of mitochondria dysfunction, or the increased energy demand by repair mechanisms and toxicant elimination [ 27 ].
statement: 在这种情况下，银鲫标准代谢率的增加可能是线粒体功能障碍诱导的结果，或者是修复机制和毒素消除导致能量需求增加的结果。
text_zh: 在这种情况下，银鲫标准代谢率的增加可能是线粒体功能障碍诱导的结果，或者是修复机制和毒素消除导致能量需求增加的结果。
text_en: In this case, the increase in standard metabolic rate of silver crucian carp may be a result of mitochondrial dysfunction induction, or a result of increased energy demand due to repair mechanisms and toxin elimination.

quote: Hypoxia impaired the aerobic metabolism of C. auratus gibelio , AS decreased because of the decrease in MMR, while peak post-prandial MO 2 decreased and time-to-peak post-prandial MO 2 increased in the hypoxic environment.
statement: 低氧环境损害了银鲫的有氧代谢，导致活动量（AS）因最大代谢率（MMR）降低而减少，同时摄食后峰值耗氧量降低且达到峰值的时间延长。
text_zh: 低氧环境损害了银鲫的有氧代谢，导致活动量（AS）因最大代谢率（MMR）降低而减少，同时摄食后峰值耗氧量降低且达到峰值的时间延长。
text_en: Hypoxic environment impaired aerobic metabolism in gibel carp, leading to reduced activity scope (AS) due to decreased maximum metabolic rate (MMR), while simultaneously reducing peak post-feeding oxygen consumption and prolonging the time to reach the peak.

quote: SMR, MMR, and AS of C. auratus gibelio decreased when exposed to hypoxic conditions.
statement: 暴露于低氧条件下时，银鲫的标准代谢率、最大代谢率和活动量均下降。
text_zh: 暴露于低氧条件下时，银鲫的标准代谢率、最大代谢率和活动量均下降。
text_en: When exposed to low oxygen conditions, the standard metabolic rate, maximum metabolic rate, and activity level of gibel carp all decreased.

quote: We suggest, therefore, that C. auratus gibelio responses to environmental hypoxia were based mainly on suppressed metabolic rate.
statement: 作者认为银鲫对环境低氧的反应主要基于代谢率的抑制。
text_zh: 作者认为银鲫对环境低氧的反应主要基于代谢率的抑制。
text_en: The authors believe that the response of gibel carp to environmental hypoxia is mainly based on metabolic rate suppression.

quote: Increased time-to-peak post-prandial MO 2 indicate that although C. auratus gibelio survives in hypoxia by low metabolic rate, they need more time for digestion.
statement: 摄食后耗氧量达峰时间的增加表明，尽管银鲫通过低代谢率在低氧中生存，但它们需要更多时间进行消化。
text_zh: 摄食后耗氧量达峰时间的增加表明，尽管银鲫通过低代谢率在低氧中生存，但它们需要更多时间进行消化。
text_en: The increase in the time to peak oxygen consumption rate after feeding indicates that although gibel carp survive in hypoxia through a low metabolic rate, they require more time for digestion.

quote: High pH impaired the aerobic metabolism of C. auratus gibelio , AS decreased because of the increase in SMR and decrease in MMR, while peak post-prandial MO 2 and time-to-peak post-prandial MO 2 both increased.
statement: 高pH值损害了银鲫的有氧代谢，由于标准代谢率增加和最大代谢率减少导致活动量下降，同时摄食后峰值耗氧量和达峰时间均增加。
text_zh: 高pH值损害了银鲫的有氧代谢，由于标准代谢率增加和最大代谢率减少导致活动量下降，同时摄食后峰值耗氧量和达峰时间均增加。
text_en: High pH impaired aerobic metabolism in gibel carp, resulting in decreased activity due to increased standard metabolic rate and decreased maximum metabolic rate, while both peak oxygen consumption after feeding and time to reach the peak increased.

quote: SMR decreased when exposed to high pH, this was likely because high pH water affected ion equilibriums and ammonia excretion [ 29 , 30 ].
statement: 暴露于高pH时标准代谢率降低，这可能是因为高pH水影响了离子平衡和氨排泄。
text_zh: 暴露于高pH时标准代谢率降低，这可能是因为高pH水影响了离子平衡和氨排泄。
text_en: Standard metabolic rate decreased when exposed to high pH, possibly because high pH water affected ion balance and ammonia excretion.

quote: If excretion of ammonia was limited, the fish would need more energy to force excretion or utilize other energetically expensive ways to excrete ammonia, which would cut into the energy available for growth.
statement: 如果氨排泄受限，鱼类需要更多能量来强制排泄或利用其他耗能高的方式排泄氨，这将减少可用于生长的能量。
text_zh: 如果氨排泄受限，鱼类需要更多能量来强制排泄或利用其他耗能高的方式排泄氨，这将减少可用于生长的能量。
text_en: If ammonia excretion is limited, fish need more energy to force excretion or use other high-energy-consuming methods to excrete ammonia, which will reduce the energy available for growth.

quote: Meanwhile, high pH and alkalinity could cause an acid base imbalance, such as respiratory alkalosis [ 4 ], thus demanding greater energy to cope with the disturbance.
statement: 同时，高pH值和碱度可能导致酸碱失衡，如呼吸性碱中毒，从而需要更多的能量来应对这种干扰。
text_zh: 同时，高pH值和碱度可能导致酸碱失衡，如呼吸性碱中毒，从而需要更多的能量来应对这种干扰。
text_en: At the same time, high pH and alkalinity may lead to acid-base imbalance, such as respiratory alkalosis, thereby requiring more energy to cope with this disturbance.

quote: The relative increase in peak post-prandial MO 2 for C. auratus gibelio exposed to high pH reached a maximum of 2.2 times higher than SMR, along with extremely narrow AS, which may result in difficulty getting food and a low ingestion rate.
statement: 暴露于高pH的银鲫餐后峰值耗氧量相对增加最高达到SMR的2.2倍，伴随极窄的活动范围，这可能导致获取食物困难和低摄食率。
text_zh: 暴露于高pH的银鲫餐后峰值耗氧量相对增加最高达到SMR的2.2倍，伴随极窄的活动范围，这可能导致获取食物困难和低摄食率。
text_en: Exposure to high pH resulted in a relative increase in postprandial peak oxygen consumption of Carassius gibelio up to 2.2 times the standard metabolic rate (SMR), accompanied by an extremely narrow activity range, which may lead to difficulty in obtaining food and low feeding rates.

quote: These findings give us some hint that extra oxygen should be provided when farming the fish in high pH water, especially during the feeding and ingestion period.
statement: 这些发现提示我们在高pH水中养殖鱼类时应提供额外氧气，特别是在喂食和摄入期间。
text_zh: 这些发现提示我们在高pH水中养殖鱼类时应提供额外氧气，特别是在喂食和摄入期间。
text_en: These findings suggest that additional oxygen should be provided when farming fish in high-pH water, especially during feeding and ingestion.
outcome: 溶氧水平与摄食期管理

quote: AS decreased by 41.5% compared to the control (Figure 1 b).
statement: 在高亚硝酸盐环境中，鲤鲫的有氧代谢范围（AS）比对照组降低了41.5%。
text_zh: 在高亚硝酸盐环境中，鲤鲫的有氧代谢范围（AS）比对照组降低了41.5%。
text_en: In a high-nitrite environment, the aerobic scope (AS) of common carp and crucian carp was reduced by 41.5% compared to the control group.

quote: SMR of C. auratus gibelio increased significantly with increasing ambient dissolved oxygen (P −1 dissolved oxygen environment (hypoxic), SMR decreased by 19.7% compared to the control (Figure 1 c).
statement: 标准代谢率（SMR）随溶解氧浓度显著变化；在低溶解氧（缺氧）环境中，SMR比对照组降低19.7%。
text_zh: 标准代谢率（SMR）随溶解氧浓度显著变化；在低溶解氧（缺氧）环境中，SMR比对照组降低19.7%。
text_en: Standard metabolic rate (SMR) varies significantly with dissolved oxygen concentration; in a low dissolved oxygen (hypoxic) environment, SMR is reduced by 19.7% compared to the control group.

quote: The MMR increased significantly with increasing ambient dissolved oxygen (P −1 hypoxia treatment, the MMR decreased by 30.6% compared to the control (Figure 1 c).
statement: 最大代谢率（MMR）随溶解氧浓度显著变化；在缺氧处理下，MMR比对照组降低30.6%。
text_zh: 最大代谢率（MMR）随溶解氧浓度显著变化；在缺氧处理下，MMR比对照组降低30.6%。
text_en: Maximum metabolic rate (MMR) varied significantly with dissolved oxygen concentration; under hypoxia treatment, MMR was reduced by 30.6% compared to the control group.

quote: AS decreased significantly with decreasing ambient dissolved oxygen (P −1 dissolved oxygen, AS decreased by 35.9% compared to the control (Figure 1 c).
statement: 有氧代谢范围（AS）随溶解氧浓度降低而显著减少；在低溶解氧环境中，AS比对照组降低35.9%。
text_zh: 有氧代谢范围（AS）随溶解氧浓度降低而显著减少；在低溶解氧环境中，AS比对照组降低35.9%。
text_en: The aerobic scope (AS) significantly decreased with decreasing dissolved oxygen concentration; in low dissolved oxygen environments, AS was 35.9% lower than the control group.

quote: Peak post-prandial MO 2 increased with decreasing dissolved oxygen (P 2 was delayed with decreasing dissolved oxygen (Figure 2 c).
statement: 随着溶解氧浓度的降低，餐后峰值耗氧量增加，且达到峰值的时间延迟。
text_zh: 随着溶解氧浓度的降低，餐后峰值耗氧量增加，且达到峰值的时间延迟。
text_en: As dissolved oxygen concentration decreases, postprandial peak oxygen consumption increases, and the time to reach the peak is delayed.

quote: SMR of C. auratus gibelio increased significantly with increasing ambient pH (P Figure 1 d).
statement: 标准代谢率（SMR）随环境pH值的升高而显著增加。
text_zh: 标准代谢率（SMR）随环境pH值的升高而显著增加。
text_en: Standard metabolic rate (SMR) significantly increases with rising environmental pH.

quote: The MMR decreased significantly with increasing ambient pH (P Figure 1 d).
statement: 最大代谢率（MMR）随环境pH值的升高而显著降低。
text_zh: 最大代谢率（MMR）随环境pH值的升高而显著降低。
text_en: Maximum metabolic rate (MMR) significantly decreases as environmental pH increases.

quote: AS decreased significantly with increasing ambient pH (P Figure 1 d).
statement: 有氧代谢范围（AS）随环境pH值的升高而显著降低。
text_zh: 有氧代谢范围（AS）随环境pH值的升高而显著降低。
text_en: The aerobic scope (AS) significantly decreases as environmental pH increases.

quote: The peak post-prandial MO 2 increased with increasing pH (P 2 was delayed with increasing pH (Figure 2 d).
statement: 随着pH值的升高，餐后峰值耗氧量增加，且达到峰值的时间延迟。
text_zh: 随着pH值的升高，餐后峰值耗氧量增加，且达到峰值的时间延迟。
text_en: As pH increases, the postprandial peak oxygen consumption rate increases, and the time to reach the peak is delayed.

quote: While being one of the most hypoxia tolerance species, C. auratus gibelio ’s AS was reduced by key stressors such as high ammonia, high nitrite, hypoxia, and high pH, that occur unpredictably in ponds and nature.
statement: 尽管鲤鲫是耐缺氧能力最强的物种之一，但其有氧代谢范围仍会因池塘和自然环境中不可预测的高氨氮、高亚硝酸盐、缺氧和高pH等关键应激源而降低。
text_zh: 尽管鲤鲫是耐缺氧能力最强的物种之一，但其有氧代谢范围仍会因池塘和自然环境中不可预测的高氨氮、高亚硝酸盐、缺氧和高pH等关键应激源而降低。
text_en: Although crucian carp is one of the species with the strongest hypoxia tolerance, its aerobic metabolic scope is still reduced by key stressors such as unpredictable high ammonia nitrogen, high nitrite, hypoxia, and high pH in ponds and natural environments.

quote: A reduction in AS can lead to a reduction in growth in aquaculture ponds or reduced fitness in nature.
statement: 有氧代谢范围的降低可能导致养殖池塘中生长速度下降或自然界中适应度降低。
text_zh: 有氧代谢范围的降低可能导致养殖池塘中生长速度下降或自然界中适应度降低。
text_en: A reduction in the aerobic scope may lead to decreased growth rates in aquaculture ponds or reduced fitness in nature.

quote: High ammonia impaired the aerobic metabolism of Carassius auratus gibelio.
statement: 高氨氮损害了银鲫的有氧代谢。
text_zh: 高氨氮损害了银鲫的有氧代谢。
text_en: High ammonia nitrogen impaired the aerobic metabolism of gibel carp.

quote: AS is used for locomotion and growth and was reduced as a function of the increase in SMR and decrease in MMR.
statement: 用于运动和生长的活动范围（AS）随着标准代谢率（SMR）的增加和最大代谢率（MMR）的降低而减少。
text_zh: 用于运动和生长的活动范围（AS）随着标准代谢率（SMR）的增加和最大代谢率（MMR）的降低而减少。
text_en: The scope for activity (AS) used for movement and growth decreases as standard metabolic rate (SMR) increases and maximum metabolic rate (MMR) decreases.

quote: A previous study suggested that the mechanism of ammonia poisoning in fish might be that ammonia interferers with amino acid transport, causing the swelling of astrocytes in the brain, disrupting the metabolism of amino acid neurotransmitters [ 19 ].
statement: 先前的研究提出，鱼类氨中毒的机制可能是氨干扰氨基酸转运，导致脑星形胶质细胞肿胀，破坏氨基酸神经递质的代谢。
text_zh: 先前的研究提出，鱼类氨中毒的机制可能是氨干扰氨基酸转运，导致脑星形胶质细胞肿胀，破坏氨基酸神经递质的代谢。
text_en: Previous studies have proposed that the mechanism of ammonia toxicity in fish may involve ammonia interfering with amino acid transport, leading to swelling of brain astrocytes and disrupting the metabolism of amino acid neurotransmitters.

quote: So, if the C. auratus gibelio needs more energy to excrete ammonia to defend against hyperammonemia, its supply of energy available to grow will be reduced.
statement: 如果银鲫需要更多能量通过能量依赖性转运体排泄氨以抵御高氨血症，其可用于生长的能量供应将减少。
text_zh: 如果银鲫需要更多能量通过能量依赖性转运体排泄氨以抵御高氨血症，其可用于生长的能量供应将减少。
text_en: If crucian carp require more energy to excrete ammonia via energy-dependent transporters to defend against hyperammonemia, the energy supply available for growth will decrease.

quote: In addition, MMR and AS both decreased after exposure to ammonia, which may result in difficulty getting food and being more easily caught by predators.
statement: 此外，暴露于氨后，最大代谢率和活动范围均下降，这可能导致获取食物困难并更容易被捕食者捕获。
text_zh: 此外，暴露于氨后，最大代谢率和活动范围均下降，这可能导致获取食物困难并更容易被捕食者捕获。
text_en: In addition, after exposure to ammonia, both the maximum metabolic rate and activity range decreased, which may lead to difficulty in obtaining food and increased vulnerability to predation.

quote: Although peak post-prandial MO 2 was not different among treatments, delayed time-to-peak post-prandial MO 2 indicated that C. auratus gibelio required more time for food ingestion.
statement: 尽管餐后峰值耗氧量在各处理间无差异，但达到餐后峰值耗氧量的时间延迟表明银鲫需要更多时间进行食物摄入。
text_zh: 尽管餐后峰值耗氧量在各处理间无差异，但达到餐后峰值耗氧量的时间延迟表明银鲫需要更多时间进行食物摄入。
text_en: Although there was no significant difference in postprandial peak oxygen consumption among treatments, the delay in reaching postprandial peak oxygen consumption indicates that Carassius gibelio requires more time for food intake.

quote: Due to the unforgiving nature of the wild, once this fish cannot meet its basic requirements, it may more easily become diseased.
statement: 由于野外环境的严酷性，一旦这种鱼无法满足其基本需求，它可能更容易患病。
text_zh: 由于野外环境的严酷性，一旦这种鱼无法满足其基本需求，它可能更容易患病。
text_en: Due to the harshness of the wild environment, once this fish cannot meet its basic needs, it may be more susceptible to disease.

quote: Therefore, we decided to evaluate the effect of induced A. coffeaeformis as a feed additive on crucian carp's growth and lipid composition.
statement: 研究旨在评估诱导后的 A. coffeaeformis 作为饲料添加剂对鲫鱼生长和脂质组成的影响。
text_zh: 研究旨在评估诱导后的 A. coffeaeformis 作为饲料添加剂对鲫鱼生长和脂质组成的影响。
text_en: The study aimed to evaluate the effects of induced A. coffeaeformis as a feed additive on the growth and lipid composition of crucian carp.

quote: As shown in Table 4 , the whole fish proximate analysis was significantly affected by A. coffeaeformis supplementation.
statement: 如表4所示，全鱼常规营养成分分析受 A. coffeaeformis 补充的显著影响。
text_zh: 如表4所示，全鱼常规营养成分分析受 A. coffeaeformis 补充的显著影响。
text_en: As shown in Table 4, the analysis of conventional nutritional components of whole fish was significantly affected by A. coffeaeformis supplementation.

quote: The crucian carps (Carassius auratus) with average body weight of ca. 10 g were randomly divided into two groups (20 crucian carps per group in triplicate) and fed with these two diets after adapting for 1 week to the experimental conditions.
statement: 鲫鱼在实验条件下适应一周后，被随机分为两组进行投喂实验。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在实验条件下适应一周后，被随机分为两组进行投喂实验。
text_en: Crucian carp, after adapting for one week under experimental conditions, were randomly divided into two groups for a feeding experiment.

quote: The test diets were given twice daily at 10:00 and 15:00 h to visual satiation.
statement: 测试饲料每天两次（10:00和15:00）投喂至视觉饱食。
text_zh: 测试饲料每天两次（10:00和15:00）投喂至视觉饱食。
text_en: The test feed was offered to visual satiation twice daily (10:00 and 15:00).

quote: The natural photoperiod was 12-h light:12-h dark throughout the feeding experiment and the water temperature was 21 ± 1.4℃.
statement: 整个喂养实验期间采用12小时光照/12小时黑暗的自然光周期，水温为21 ± 1.4℃。
text_zh: 整个喂养实验期间采用12小时光照/12小时黑暗的自然光周期，水温为21 ± 1.4℃。
text_en: A natural photoperiod of 12 hours light/12 hours dark was used throughout the entire feeding experiment, with a water temperature of 21 ± 1.4°C.
